a2-u7-l1.vylet.note.en: You know výlet from unit 2. **Po** + the locative means around: po Slovensku, po meste. In May the four friends are going on one.
a2-u7-l1.vylet.note.t: výlet soʻzini 2-boʻlimdan bilasiz. **Po** + lokál (oʻrin-payt kelishigi) «…boʻylab» degani: po Slovensku (Slovakiya boʻylab), po meste (shahar boʻylab). May oyida toʻrt doʻst shunday sayohatga chiqadi.

a2-u7-l1.hory.note.en: You know hory from unit 1. Going there: **do hôr**, **do Tatier**; being there: **v horách**, **v Tatrách**. The Tatry are the best known.
a2-u7-l1.hory.note.t: hory soʻzini 1-boʻlimdan bilasiz. U yerga borish: **do hôr**, **do Tatier** (togʻlarga, Tatra togʻlariga); u yerda boʻlish: **v horách**, **v Tatrách** (togʻlarda, Tatra togʻlarida). Eng mashhurlari — Tatra togʻlari.

en: In May we're going on a trip to the mountains.
In May we were on a trip in the mountains.
In May we're going to the seaside.

a2-u7-l1.choice-v-maji-ideme.why.en: **Ideme** is the present of ísť, used here for a plan, just like “we're going”. The past would be išli sme. And **do hôr** = to the mountains.
a2-u7-l1.choice-v-maji-ideme.why.t: **Ideme** — ísť feʼlining hozirgi zamoni, bu yerda reja uchun ishlatilgan, oʻzbekchadagi «boramiz» kabi. Oʻtgan zamon išli sme boʻlardi. **do hôr** esa «togʻlarga».

a2-u7-l1.mat-v-plane.en.en: to plan, to have in mind

a2-u7-l1.mat-v-plane.note.en: Čo máme v pláne? = What's the plan? **Máme v pláne** ísť do Tatier. = We're planning to go to the Tatras.
a2-u7-l1.mat-v-plane.note.t: Čo máme v pláne? = Rejamiz qanday? **Máme v pláne** ísť do Tatier. = Tatra togʻlariga borishni rejalashtiryapmiz.

a2-u7-l1.fill-v-piatok-mame.en.en: On Friday we're planning to go to Orava Castle.
a2-u7-l1.fill-v-piatok-mame.en.t: Juma kuni Orava qalʼasiga borishni rejalashtiryapmiz.

a2-u7-l1.fill-v-piatok-mame.why.en: **Mať v pláne** is a set phrase. After v (where?), plán takes the locative ending **-e**: v **pláne**, like v obchode.
a2-u7-l1.fill-v-piatok-mame.why.t: **Mať v pláne** — turgʻun ibora. V («qayerda?») dan keyin plán lokál qoʻshimchasi **-e** ni oladi: v **pláne**, xuddi v obchode kabi.

a2-u7-l1.fill-cez-vikend-budeme.en.en: We'll be in the mountains at the weekend.

a2-u7-l1.fill-cez-vikend-budeme.why.en: The weekend is still to come, so byť takes its future form, and “we” is my: **budeme**. Sme is now, budú is oni.
a2-u7-l1.fill-cez-vikend-budeme.why.t: Dam olish kunlari hali oldinda, shuning uchun byť kelasi zamon shaklida keladi, «biz» esa my: **budeme**. Sme — hozir, budú — oni (ular) shakli.

a2-u7-l1.navrh.question.en: Emma has an idea for the trip. What does she say?
a2-u7-l1.navrh.question.t: Emmaning sayohat uchun bir fikri bor. U nima deydi?

a2-u7-l1.build-mam-navrh-pojdeme.prompt.en: I have a suggestion: we'll go to the Tatras.
a2-u7-l1.build-mam-navrh-pojdeme.prompt.t: Bir taklifim bor: Tatra togʻlariga boramiz.

en: Ísť has its own future: **pôjdeme**. It never takes budeme.
“We” is my, so pôjd**eme**. Pôjdem is ja.
t: Ísť feʼlining oʻz kelasi zamoni bor: **pôjdeme**. U hech qachon budeme bilan kelmaydi.
«Biz» — my, shuning uchun pôjd**eme**. Pôjdem — ja (men) shakli.

a2-u7-l1.choice-to-znie-dobre.question.en: Lucia suggests a weekend in the Tatras. Tomáš likes the idea. What does he say?
a2-u7-l1.choice-to-znie-dobre.question.t: Lusiya dam olish kunlarini Tatra togʻlarida oʻtkazishni taklif qilyapti. Tomashga bu fikr yoqdi. U nima deydi?

a2-u7-l1.uz-sa-neviem-dockat.note.en: Say it when you're really looking forward to something. **Teším sa.** (I'm looking forward to it) is the calmer version.
a2-u7-l1.uz-sa-neviem-dockat.note.t: Biror narsani juda intiqlik bilan kutayotganingizda shunday deysiz. **Teším sa.** (Intiqlik bilan kutyapman.) — xotirjamroq varianti.

a2-u7-l1.fill-v-maji-pojdeme.en.en: In May we'll go on a trip for four days.
a2-u7-l1.fill-v-maji-pojdeme.en.t: May oyida toʻrt kunlik sayohatga boramiz.

a2-u7-l1.fill-v-maji-pojdeme.why.en: Ísť has its own future: **pôjdeme** for my. It never takes budeme. Pôjdete is vy.
a2-u7-l1.fill-v-maji-pojdeme.why.t: Ísť feʼlining oʻz kelasi zamoni bor: my uchun **pôjdeme**. U hech qachon budeme bilan kelmaydi. Pôjdete — vy (siz) shakli.

a2-u7-l1.fill-marek-moze-ist.en.en: Marek can go to the mountains. His arm doesn't hurt any more.
a2-u7-l1.fill-marek-moze-ist.en.t: Marek togʻlarga bora oladi. Qoʻli endi ogʻrimayapti.

a2-u7-l1.fill-marek-moze-ist.why.en: **Už** with a negative verb means “not any more”: už **ne**bolí. Ruka is one thing, so bolí, not bolia.
a2-u7-l1.fill-marek-moze-ist.why.t: **Už** inkor shaklidagi feʼl bilan «endi … emas» degani: už **ne**bolí (endi ogʻrimayapti). Ruka — bitta narsa, shuning uchun bolí, bolia emas.

en: In **mať v pláne**, plán comes after v and takes the locative: v **pláne**.
The plan is for all of us, my: **máme**. Mám is ja.
t: **mať v pláne** iborasida plán v dan keyin keladi va lokál shaklini oladi: v **pláne**.
Reja hammamiz uchun, yaʼni my: **máme**. Mám — ja (men) shakli.

en: Emma has a suggestion: first we'll go to the castle.
Emma has a suggestion: we'll go to the castle first.
t: Emmaning taklifi bor: avval qalʼaga boramiz.
Emmaning bir taklifi bor: avval qalʼaga boramiz.
Emmaning taklifi bor: oldin qalʼaga boramiz.

a2-u7-l2.som-na-ceste.note.en: **cesta** = road, way, journey. Friday morning, in Tomáš's car: **Sme na ceste**, pred chvíľou sme odišli z Bratislavy. = We're on our way, we left Bratislava a moment ago. **Okolo jednej** = at about one.
a2-u7-l2.som-na-ceste.note.t: **cesta** = yoʻl, safar. Juma kuni ertalab, Tomashning mashinasida: **Sme na ceste**, pred chvíľou sme odišli z Bratislavy. = Yoʻldamiz, hozirgina Bratislavadan chiqdik. **Okolo jednej** = soat birlar atrofida.

a2-u7-l2.davaj-si-pozor.note.en: Lucia's mum says it every time, and Lucia answers: Áno, **mami** (Mum). To someone you call vy: **Dávajte si pozor!**
a2-u7-l2.davaj-si-pozor.note.t: Lusiyaning onasi har safar shunday deydi, Lusiya esa javob beradi: Áno, **mami** (Ha, oyi). «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: **Dávajte si pozor!**

a2-u7-l2.choice-sme-na-ceste.question.en: Lucia's mum calls. Lucia is in the car with her friends. What does she say?
a2-u7-l2.choice-sme-na-ceste.question.t: Lusiyaning onasi qoʻngʻiroq qilyapti. Lusiya doʻstlari bilan mashinada. U nima deydi?

a2-u7-l2.choice-sme-na-ceste.why.en: She's in the car with the others, so it's my: **sme** na ceste, we're on our way.
a2-u7-l2.choice-sme-na-ceste.why.t: U boshqalar bilan birga mashinada, shuning uchun my: **sme** na ceste — yoʻldamiz.

a2-u7-l2.fill-pred-chvilou-sme.en.en: We left Bratislava a moment ago.

a2-u7-l2.fill-pred-chvilou-sme.why.en: With **sme** (my), the past form ends in **-li**: odiš**li**. Odišiel is on, odišla is ona.
a2-u7-l2.fill-pred-chvilou-sme.why.t: **sme** (my) bilan oʻtgan zamon shakli **-li** bilan tugaydi: odiš**li**. Odišiel — on, odišla — ona shakli.

en: It's **dávať si** pozor, with si: Dávaj **si** pozor.
Lucia is family, so ty: **Dávaj**. Dávajte is for vy.
t: Bu **dávať si** pozor, si bilan: Dávaj **si** pozor.
Lusiya — oila aʼzosi, shuning uchun ty: **Dávaj**. Dávajte — vy uchun.

a2-u7-l2.nerob-si-starosti.note.en: Also: **Neboj sa.** = Don't be afraid. To vy: Nerobte si starosti.
a2-u7-l2.nerob-si-starosti.note.t: Yana: **Neboj sa.** = Qoʻrqma. «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: Nerobte si starosti.

a2-u7-l2.choice-nerob-si-starosti.questi.en: Lucia's mum is worried about the trip. What does Lucia tell her?
a2-u7-l2.choice-nerob-si-starosti.questi.t: Lusiyaning onasi sayohat haqida xavotirda. Lusiya unga nima deydi?

a2-u7-l2.fill-okolo-jednej-budeme.en.en: We'll be in Oravský Podzámok at about one.
a2-u7-l2.fill-okolo-jednej-budeme.en.t: Soat birlar atrofida Oravski Podzamokda boʻlamiz.

a2-u7-l2.fill-okolo-jednej-budeme.why.en: One o'clock is still to come, so byť takes its future form: **budeme**. Sme is now, boli sme the past.
a2-u7-l2.fill-okolo-jednej-budeme.why.t: Soat bir hali oldinda, shuning uchun byť kelasi zamon shaklida: **budeme**. Sme — hozir, boli sme — oʻtgan zamon.

a2-u7-l2.zdravotnik.note.en: Lucia's mum is a nurse (zdravotná sestra, unit 5), so she's a zdravotníčka, a health worker, at the hospital in Žilina. That's why she always worries.
a2-u7-l2.zdravotnik.note.t: Lusiyaning onasi hamshira (zdravotná sestra, 5-boʻlim), demak u Jilinadagi kasalxonada **zdravotníčka**, yaʼni tibbiyot xodimi. Shuning uchun u doim xavotir oladi.

a2-u7-l2.fill-mama-je-zdravotnicka.en.en: Mum is a health worker and she always worries.
a2-u7-l2.fill-mama-je-zdravotnicka.en.t: Oyim tibbiyot xodimi, u doim xavotir oladi.

a2-u7-l2.fill-mama-je-zdravotnicka.why.en: Mama is a woman, so the job takes its feminine form: **zdravotníčka**, like čašník → čašníčka.
a2-u7-l2.fill-mama-je-zdravotnicka.why.t: Mama — ayol, shuning uchun kasb nomi ayol jinsi shaklida keladi: **zdravotníčka**, xuddi čašník → čašníčka kabi.

a2-u7-l2.o-co-som-prisla.en.en: What have I missed? (a woman speaking)

a2-u7-l2.o-co-som-prisla.note.en: Emma wakes up in the car. **Prísť o** something = to miss it, to lose it. Lucia laughs: O nič! (Nothing!)
a2-u7-l2.o-co-som-prisla.note.t: Emma mashinada uygʻonadi. **Prísť o** biror narsa = uni oʻtkazib yubormoq, yoʻqotmoq. Lusiya kuladi: O nič! (Hech narsani!)

a2-u7-l2.choice-o-co-som.question.en: Tomáš has been asleep in the car while Marek drives. What does he ask when he wakes up?
a2-u7-l2.choice-o-co-som.question.t: Marek mashina haydayotganda Tomash uxlab qolgan edi. U uygʻonib nima deb soʻraydi?

a2-u7-l2.choice-o-co-som.why.en: Tomáš is a man, so the past form has no ending: **prišiel** som. Prišla is for a woman.
a2-u7-l2.choice-o-co-som.why.t: Tomash — erkak, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon shakli qoʻshimchasiz: **prišiel** som. Prišla — ayol uchun.

a2-u7-l2.dufam-ze-to.note.en: **dúfať** = to hope. The castle tour starts at two, and stihneme (from stihnúť) = we'll make it in time.
a2-u7-l2.dufam-ze-to.note.t: **dúfať** = umid qilmoq. Qalʼadagi ekskursiya soat ikkida boshlanadi, stihneme (stihnúť feʼlidan) = vaqtida yetib boramiz, ulguramiz.

en: We'll make it: my, so **stihneme**. Stihnem is ja.
I hope: ja, so **Dúfam**. Dúfaš is ty.
t: «Ulguramiz» — my, shuning uchun **stihneme**. Stihnem — ja shakli.
«Umid qilaman» — ja, shuning uchun **Dúfam**. Dúfaš — ty shakli.

a2-u7-l2.listen-sme-na-ceste.en.en: We're on our way, we'll be there in an hour.
a2-u7-l2.listen-sme-na-ceste.en.t: Yoʻldamiz, bir soatdan keyin u yerda boʻlamiz.

en: We left Bratislava a moment ago.
A moment ago we left Bratislava.

a2-u7-l3.titleEn.en: Doing it, or getting it done

a2-u7-l3.grammar-process-or-result.title.en: Process or result: two kinds of verb
a2-u7-l3.grammar-process-or-result.title.t: Jarayon yoki natija: feʼlning ikki turi

en: Most Slovak verbs come in pairs. The **imperfective** verb (nedokonavé) shows the action as a process: what someone was doing, and for how long. The **perfective** verb (dokonavé) shows the result: the action finished, done.
Many perfectives just add a prefix: písať → **na**písať. The rest stays the same, so the past is easy: písal → **na**písal.
t: Koʻp slovak feʼllari juft boʻlib keladi. **Tugallanmagan tur** (nedokonavé) harakatni jarayon sifatida koʻrsatadi: kim nima qilayotgan edi va qancha vaqt. **Tugallangan tur** (dokonavé) natijani koʻrsatadi: harakat oxiriga yetdi, bajarildi. Oʻzbekchada shunga yaqin farq bor: «yozdi» va «yozib boʻldi».
Koʻp tugallangan feʼllar shunchaki old qoʻshimcha oladi: písať → **na**písať. Qolgani oʻzgarmaydi, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon oson: písal → **na**písal.

en: Emma spent an hour writing an e-mail.
t: Emma bir soat davomida elektron xat yozdi.
Emma elektron xatni yozib boʻldi (xat tayyor).
Marek kechki ovqatni pishirib boʻldi (ovqat tayyor).

a2-u7-l3.fill-emma-hodinu-pisala.en.en: Emma spent an hour writing an e-mail home.
a2-u7-l3.fill-emma-hodinu-pisala.en.t: Emma bir soat davomida uyga elektron xat yozdi.

a2-u7-l3.fill-emma-hodinu-pisala.why.en: **Hodinu** (for an hour) shows the action as a process, so the imperfective: **písala**. Napísala would only say the e-mail is finished.
a2-u7-l3.fill-emma-hodinu-pisala.why.t: **Hodinu** (bir soat davomida) harakatni jarayon sifatida koʻrsatadi, shuning uchun tugallanmagan tur: **písala**. Napísala faqat xat yozib boʻlinganini aytardi.

a2-u7-l3.choice-marek-uvaril-veceru.ques.en: Which one says that dinner is ready?
a2-u7-l3.choice-marek-uvaril-veceru.ques.t: Qaysi gap kechki ovqat tayyor ekanini aytadi?

a2-u7-l3.choice-marek-uvaril-veceru.why.en: The perfective **uvaril** gives the result: dinner is cooked. Varil only says he was cooking, and bude variť is still to come.
a2-u7-l3.choice-marek-uvaril-veceru.why.t: Tugallangan **uvaril** natijani bildiradi: ovqat pishib boʻldi. Varil faqat u ovqat pishirayotganini aytadi, bude variť esa hali oldinda.

a2-u7-l3.fill-tomas-zaplatil-za.en.en: Tomáš paid for the coffee and now he's waiting in the car.
a2-u7-l3.fill-tomas-zaplatil-za.en.t: Tomash qahva uchun pul toʻladi va endi mashinada kutyapti.

a2-u7-l3.fill-tomas-zaplatil-za.why.en: The paying is over and he's waiting: that's the result, so the perfective **zaplatil**.
a2-u7-l3.fill-tomas-zaplatil-za.why.t: Toʻlov tugadi va u kutyapti: bu natija, shuning uchun tugallangan tur **zaplatil**.

a2-u7-l3.fill-lucia-uz-precitala.en.en: Lucia has already read the whole book; now Marek is reading it.
a2-u7-l3.fill-lucia-uz-precitala.en.t: Lusiya butun kitobni oʻqib boʻldi, endi uni Marek oʻqiyapti.

a2-u7-l3.fill-lucia-uz-precitala.why.en: The whole book is finished and now someone else has it: that's the result, the perfective **prečítala**.
a2-u7-l3.fill-lucia-uz-precitala.why.t: Butun kitob oʻqib boʻlindi va endi u boshqa odamda: bu natija, tugallangan **prečítala**.

a2-u7-l3.build-emma-hodinu-citala.prompt.en: Emma was reading for an hour.

en: For an hour (hodinu) is a process: the imperfective **čítala**. Prečítala would say she finished something.
It was in the past, so the past form: **čítala**. Číta is now.
t: Bir soat davomida (hodinu) — jarayon: tugallanmagan **čítala**. Prečítala biror narsani oʻqib tugatganini aytardi.
Bu oʻtgan zamonda boʻlgan, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon shakli: **čítala**. Číta — hozir.

a2-u7-l3.fill-uz-som-zavolala.en.en: I've already called home. Mum knows we're on our way.
a2-u7-l3.fill-uz-som-zavolala.en.t: Uyga allaqachon qoʻngʻiroq qildim. Oyim yoʻlda ekanimizni biladi.

a2-u7-l3.fill-uz-som-zavolala.why.en: The call is done and Mum knows: that's the result, the perfective **zavolala**.
a2-u7-l3.fill-uz-som-zavolala.why.t: Qoʻngʻiroq qilindi va oyim xabardor: bu natija, tugallangan **zavolala**.

a2-u7-l3.fill-co-si-robil.en.en: What did you do at the weekend, Tomáš?
a2-u7-l3.fill-co-si-robil.en.t: Dam olish kunlari nima qilding, Tomash?

a2-u7-l3.fill-co-si-robil.why.en: Asking about the weekend's activities, the process, takes the imperfective: Čo si **robil**? Urobil asks what you got done.
a2-u7-l3.fill-co-si-robil.why.t: Dam olish kunlaridagi mashgʻulotlar, yaʼni jarayon haqida soʻralganda tugallanmagan tur keladi: Čo si **robil**? Urobil esa nimani qilib boʻlganingizni soʻraydi.

a2-u7-l3.grammar-perfective-no-present.t.en: A perfective verb has no present

en: In A1 you saw that kúpim and zavolám already point to the future. That's true of every perfective verb: it has **no present** tense, and its present form always means the future. **Napíšem** = I'll write it.
What's going on right now is always imperfective: **Píšem** e-mail. = I'm writing an e-mail.
t: A1 da kúpim va zavolám allaqachon kelasi zamonni bildirishini koʻrgansiz. Bu har bir tugallangan feʼlga tegishli: unda **hozirgi zamon yoʻq**, hozirgi zamon shakli esa doim kelasi zamonni bildiradi. **Napíšem** = yozaman (yozib qoʻyaman).
Ayni paytda boʻlayotgan ish doim tugallanmagan tur bilan aytiladi: **Píšem** e-mail. = Elektron xat yozyapman.

a2-u7-l3.choice-emma-pise-e-mail.questio.en: Which sentence is about right now?
a2-u7-l3.choice-emma-pise-e-mail.questio.t: Qaysi gap ayni paytdagi ish haqida?

a2-u7-l3.choice-emma-pise-e-mail.why.en: Right now is always imperfective: **píše**. Napíše is a perfective, so it means she'll write it later.
a2-u7-l3.choice-emma-pise-e-mail.why.t: Ayni paytdagi ish doim tugallanmagan turda: **píše**. Napíše — tugallangan tur, demak u xatni keyinroq yozadi.

a2-u7-l3.fill-neboj-sa-mami.en.en: Don't worry, Mum, I'll call you this evening.
a2-u7-l3.fill-neboj-sa-mami.en.t: Xavotir olma, oyi, kechqurun senga qoʻngʻiroq qilaman.

a2-u7-l3.fill-neboj-sa-mami.why.en: One call, later: the perfective **zavolám** already means the future. Volám is now: I'm calling.
a2-u7-l3.fill-neboj-sa-mami.why.t: Bitta qoʻngʻiroq, keyinroq: tugallangan **zavolám** allaqachon kelasi zamonni bildiradi. Volám — hozir: qoʻngʻiroq qilyapman.

a2-u7-l3.build-vecer-napisem-e-mail.prom.en: I'll write the e-mail this evening.

en: Napísať is perfective: its present form is already the future, so no budem: **napíšem**.
Píšem is now: I'm writing. For the finished e-mail later, the perfective: **napíšem**.
t: Napísať — tugallangan tur: uning hozirgi zamon shakli allaqachon kelasi zamon, shuning uchun budem kerak emas: **napíšem**.
Píšem — hozir: yozyapman. Keyinroq tayyor boʻladigan xat uchun tugallangan tur kerak: **napíšem**.

a2-u7-l3.fill-marek-prave-vari.en.en: Marek is cooking lunch right now.

a2-u7-l3.fill-marek-prave-vari.why.en: **Práve** (right now) needs the present, and only the imperfective has one: **varí**. Uvarí means he'll get it cooked later.
a2-u7-l3.fill-marek-prave-vari.why.t: **Práve** (ayni paytda) hozirgi zamonni talab qiladi, u esa faqat tugallanmagan turda bor: **varí**. Uvarí — keyinroq pishirib qoʻyadi degani.

a2-u7-l3.fill-lucia-vypila-cely.en.en: Lucia has drunk all her tea and wants another one.
a2-u7-l3.fill-lucia-vypila-cely.en.t: Lusiya choyini ichib boʻldi va yana bittasini xohlayapti.

a2-u7-l3.fill-lucia-vypila-cely.why.en: All the tea is gone: that's the result, so the perfective **vypila**.
a2-u7-l3.fill-lucia-vypila-cely.why.t: Choy tugadi: bu natija, shuning uchun tugallangan **vypila**.

en: I'm reading now, I'll finish the book tomorrow.
I'm reading now and I'll finish the book tomorrow.
t: Hozir oʻqiyapman, kitobni ertaga oʻqib tugataman.
Hozir oʻqiyapman, ertaga kitobni oʻqib tugataman.

a2-u7-l4.vstupenka.note.en: Orava Castle, Friday, at the ticket office (**pokladňa**): Štyri vstupenky, prosím. You'll also hear **lístok**: lístok na hrad.
a2-u7-l4.vstupenka.note.t: Orava qalʼasi, juma, kassada (**pokladňa**): Štyri vstupenky, prosím. **lístok** soʻzini ham eshitasiz: lístok na hrad.

a2-u7-l4.prehliadka.note.en: **prehliadka hradu** = a tour of the castle. Ako dlho **trvá**? – Hodinu a pol. = How long does it take? – An hour and a half.
a2-u7-l4.prehliadka.note.t: **prehliadka hradu** = qalʼa boʻylab ekskursiya. Ako dlho **trvá**? – Hodinu a pol. = Qancha davom etadi? – Bir yarim soat.

a2-u7-l4.fill-styri-vstupenky-na.en.en: Four tickets for the tour, please.

a2-u7-l4.fill-styri-vstupenky-na.why.en: After 2, 3 and 4 comes the plural: štyri **vstupenky**, like dve rieky.
a2-u7-l4.fill-styri-vstupenky-na.why.t: 2, 3 va 4 dan keyin koʻplik keladi: štyri **vstupenky**, xuddi dve rieky kabi.

a2-u7-l4.fill-ako-dlho-trva.en.en: How long does the tour take?

a2-u7-l4.fill-ako-dlho-trva.why.en: Prehliadka is one thing (ona), so the verb has no ending: **trvá**. Trvajú is oni, trvám ja.
a2-u7-l4.fill-ako-dlho-trva.why.t: Prehliadka — bitta narsa (ona), shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz: **trvá**. Trvajú — oni, trvám — ja shakli.

a2-u7-l4.prehliadka-je-vypredana.note.en: The two o'clock tour has no tickets left: Ďalšia je o tretej. = The next one is at three. Emma sighs: **Škoda!** = What a pity!
a2-u7-l4.prehliadka-je-vypredana.note.t: Soat ikkidagi ekskursiyaga chipta qolmagan: Ďalšia je o tretej. = Keyingisi soat uchda. Emma xoʻrsinadi: **Škoda!** = Attang!

a2-u7-l4.build-skoda-ze-prehliadka.promp.en: It's a pity the tour is sold out.

en: Prehliadka is feminine, so the adjective ends in **-á**: vypredan**á**.
The tour is the subject here, so it keeps its -a: **prehliadka** je…
t: Prehliadka — ayol jinsida, shuning uchun sifat **-á** bilan tugaydi: vypredan**á**.
Bu yerda ekskursiya — ega, shuning uchun -a saqlanadi: **prehliadka** je…

a2-u7-l4.studentsky-preukaz.note.en: Máte študentský preukaz? With one you get the zľava from unit 2: študenti majú zľavu.
a2-u7-l4.studentsky-preukaz.note.t: Máte študentský preukaz? U bilan 2-boʻlimdagi zľava (chegirma) olasiz: študenti majú zľavu.

a2-u7-l4.build-mate-studentsky-preukaz.p.en: The cashier asks Emma: Do you have a student card?
a2-u7-l4.build-mate-studentsky-preukaz.p.t: Kassir Emmadan soʻraydi: Talaba guvohnomangiz bormi?

The cashier doesn't know Emma, so she says vy: **Máte**.
t: Preukaz — erkak jinsida, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** bilan tugaydi: **študentský** preukaz.
Kassir Emmani tanimaydi, shuning uchun vy deydi: **Máte**.

a2-u7-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia.en.en: Emma and Lucia are students, so they get a discount.
a2-u7-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia.en.t: Emma va Lusiya talaba, shuning uchun ularga chegirma bor.

a2-u7-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia.why.en: The discount is what they have, the object, so zľava changes -a to **-u**: majú **zľavu**.
a2-u7-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia.why.t: Chegirma — ularda bor narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun zľava soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: majú **zľavu**.

a2-u7-l4.priplatok.note.en: Fotografovať môžete, ale je tu **príplatok** dve eurá. = You can take photos, but there's a two-euro extra charge.
a2-u7-l4.priplatok.note.t: Fotografovať môžete, ale je tu **príplatok** dve eurá. = Suratga olishingiz mumkin, lekin buning uchun ikki yevro qoʻshimcha toʻlov bor.

a2-u7-l4.fill-styri-vstupenky-a.en.en: Four tickets and the extra charge: that's forty euros altogether.
a2-u7-l4.fill-styri-vstupenky-a.en.t: Toʻrtta chipta va qoʻshimcha toʻlov: hammasi boʻlib qirq yevro.

a2-u7-l4.fill-styri-vstupenky-a.why.en: From five up, euro takes its short form: štyridsať **eur**, like päť eur. Eurá is for 2, 3 and 4.
a2-u7-l4.fill-styri-vstupenky-a.why.t: Beshdan boshlab euro qisqa shaklni oladi: štyridsať **eur**, xuddi päť eur kabi. Eurá — 2, 3 va 4 uchun.

a2-u7-l4.sprievodca.note.en: Plural like dôchodca: dvaja sprievodcovia. A **hrad** is a castle; a grand house like Bojnický **zámok** is a chateau.
a2-u7-l4.sprievodca.note.t: Koʻpligi dôchodca kabi: dvaja sprievodcovia. **hrad** — qalʼa; Bojnický **zámok** kabi hashamatli bino esa qasr.

a2-u7-l4.fill-nasa-sprievodkyna-je.en.en: Our guide is young and very nice.

a2-u7-l4.fill-nasa-sprievodkyna-je.why.en: Naša, mladá and milá are all feminine, so the guide is a woman: **sprievodkyňa**.
a2-u7-l4.fill-nasa-sprievodkyna-je.why.t: Naša, mladá va milá — hammasi ayol jinsida, demak gid ayol: **sprievodkyňa**.

a2-u7-l4.chceli-sme-vas.note.en: After the tour, Lucia's parents are waiting at the gate: they've come over from Žilina. Lucia: **Tak to sa vám podarilo!** = Well, you've managed it!
a2-u7-l4.chceli-sme-vas.note.t: Ekskursiyadan keyin Lusiyaning ota-onasi darvoza oldida kutib turibdi: ular Jilinadan kelishgan. Lusiya: **Tak to sa vám podarilo!** = Ha, buni uddalabsizlar!

a2-u7-l4.fill-lucia-je-velmi.why.en: Lucia is a woman, so the adjective ends in **-á**: prekvapen**á**.
a2-u7-l4.fill-lucia-je-velmi.why.t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun sifat **-á** bilan tugaydi: prekvapen**á**.

en: Mum and Dad wanted to surprise us.
t: Oyim va dadam bizga syurpriz qilmoqchi edi.
Oyim bilan dadam bizga syurpriz qilmoqchi edi.

Oyim va dadam bizga syurpriz qilmoqchi edilar.

en: The imperfective also tells what happens again and again: habits and routines, with words like **vždy**, **často**, **každý deň** (every day) and **obyčajne** (usually, like zvyčajne).
The perfective tells about one occasion, done once: **dnes**, **včera**, **raz** (once).
t: Tugallanmagan tur qayta-qayta boʻladigan ishni ham bildiradi: odat va kundalik ishlarni, **vždy** (doim), **často** (tez-tez), **každý deň** (har kuni) va **obyčajne** (odatda, zvyčajne kabi) soʻzlari bilan.
Tugallangan tur bir martalik, bir marta bajarilgan ishni bildiradi: **dnes** (bugun), **včera** (kecha), **raz** (bir marta).

en: Lucia visits her parents every month.
In May we visited Orava Castle.
I usually get up at seven.
Today I got up at five.
t: Lusiya har oy ota-onasinikiga borib turadi.

a2-u7-l5.fill-lucia-navstevuje-rodicov.e.en: Lucia visits her parents in Žilina every month.
a2-u7-l5.fill-lucia-navstevuje-rodicov.e.t: Lusiya har oy Jilinadagi ota-onasinikiga borib turadi.

a2-u7-l5.fill-lucia-navstevuje-rodicov.w.en: **Každý mesiac** (every month) is a habit, so the imperfective: **navštevuje**. Navštívi is one visit, later.
a2-u7-l5.fill-lucia-navstevuje-rodicov.w.t: **Každý mesiac** (har oy) — odat, shuning uchun tugallanmagan tur: **navštevuje**. Navštívi — keyinroq boʻladigan bitta tashrif.

a2-u7-l5.fill-obycajne-vstavam-o.en.en: I usually get up at seven, but today I got up at five.
a2-u7-l5.fill-obycajne-vstavam-o.en.t: Odatda soat yettida turaman, lekin bugun soat beshda turdim.

a2-u7-l5.fill-obycajne-vstavam-o.why.en: **Obyčajne** (usually) is a habit, so the imperfective: **vstávam**. Vstanem is one morning, later.
a2-u7-l5.fill-obycajne-vstavam-o.why.t: **Obyčajne** (odatda) — odat, shuning uchun tugallanmagan tur: **vstávam**. Vstanem — keyinroq boʻladigan bitta ertalab.

a2-u7-l5.fill-vcera-sme-navstivili.why.en: **Včera**, one visit: the perfective **navštívili**. Navštevovali would mean we kept going there.
a2-u7-l5.fill-vcera-sme-navstivili.why.t: **Včera** (kecha), bitta tashrif: tugallangan **navštívili**. Navštevovali u yerga qayta-qayta borib turganimizni bildirardi.

en: A habit (obyčajne) takes the imperfective: **platím**. Zaplatím is one payment, later.
By card: the instrumental, **kartou**, as in Platím kartou.
t: Odat (obyčajne) tugallanmagan turni talab qiladi: **platím**. Zaplatím — keyinroq boʻladigan bitta toʻlov.
«Karta bilan» — inštrumentál, yaʼni «bilan» shakli: **kartou**, xuddi Platím kartou kabi.

a2-u7-l5.grammar-pairs-suffix-other.titl.en: Pairs with a different ending, or a different verb
a2-u7-l5.grammar-pairs-suffix-other.titl.t: Oʻrtasi oʻzgaradigan yoki butunlay boshqa feʼldan iborat juftliklar

en: In many pairs the middle of the verb changes instead of a prefix. Often the imperfective is the longer one: kup**ova**ť → kúpiť, vstá**va**ť → vstať.
A few pairs are two different verbs: **hľadať → nájsť** (look for → find), **hovoriť → povedať** (speak → say), **brať → zobrať** or **vziať** (take).
Nájsť has its own past: **našiel, našla, našli**. And poslať goes **pošlem**, pošleš, pošle…
t: Koʻp juftliklarda old qoʻshimcha qoʻshilmaydi, feʼlning oʻrtasi oʻzgaradi. Koʻpincha tugallanmagan tur uzunroq boʻladi: kup**ova**ť → kúpiť, vstá**va**ť → vstať.
Baʼzi juftliklar ikki xil feʼldan iborat: **hľadať → nájsť** (qidirmoq → topmoq), **hovoriť → povedať** (gapirmoq → aytmoq), **brať → zobrať** yoki **vziať** (olmoq).
Nájsť feʼlining oʻz oʻtgan zamoni bor: **našiel, našla, našli**. Poslať esa shunday tuslanadi: **pošlem**, pošleš, pošle…

en: Emma is looking for her phone.
She found it in the car.

a2-u7-l5.fill-tomas-kupil-styri.en.en: Tomáš has bought four tickets. Here they are!
a2-u7-l5.fill-tomas-kupil-styri.en.t: Tomash toʻrtta chipta sotib oldi. Mana ular!

a2-u7-l5.fill-tomas-kupil-styri.why.en: The tickets are here: that's the result, so the perfective **kúpil**. Kupoval is the process, or a habit.
a2-u7-l5.fill-tomas-kupil-styri.why.t: Chiptalar shu yerda: bu natija, shuning uchun tugallangan **kúpil**. Kupoval — jarayon yoki odat.

a2-u7-l5.choice-tomas-vzdy-kupuje.questi.en: Which sentence is about a habit?

a2-u7-l5.choice-tomas-vzdy-kupuje.why.en: **Vždy** with the imperfective **kupuje**: he does it every time. Kúpil and kúpi are about one occasion.
a2-u7-l5.choice-tomas-vzdy-kupuje.why.t: **Vždy** tugallanmagan **kupuje** bilan: u buni har safar qiladi. Kúpil va kúpi bitta holat haqida.

a2-u7-l5.fill-pokladna-sa-kazdy.en.en: The ticket office opens at nine every day.
a2-u7-l5.fill-pokladna-sa-kazdy.en.t: Kassa har kuni soat toʻqqizda ochiladi.

a2-u7-l5.fill-pokladna-sa-kazdy.why.en: Every day is a habit, so the imperfective: **otvára**. Otvorí means it will open once, later.
a2-u7-l5.fill-pokladna-sa-kazdy.why.t: Har kuni — odat, shuning uchun tugallanmagan tur: **otvára**. Otvorí — keyinroq bir marta ochiladi degani.

a2-u7-l5.choice-nasla-som-mobil.question.en: Emma has been looking for her phone, and now she has it. What does she say?
a2-u7-l5.choice-nasla-som-mobil.question.t: Emma telefonini qidirayotgan edi, endi u topildi. Emma nima deydi?

a2-u7-l5.choice-nasla-som-mobil.why.en: Finding is the result of looking, the perfective nájsť: **našla** som. Hľadala and hľadám are only the looking.
a2-u7-l5.choice-nasla-som-mobil.why.t: Topish — qidirishning natijasi, tugallangan nájsť: **našla** som. Hľadala va hľadám — faqat qidirish.

a2-u7-l5.fill-emma-uz-dobre.why.en: Speaking a language goes on all the time, a process: the imperfective **hovorí**. Povie is one thing said, later.
a2-u7-l5.fill-emma-uz-dobre.why.t: Tilda gapirish doimiy davom etadigan jarayon: tugallanmagan **hovorí**. Povie — keyinroq aytiladigan bitta gap.

en: Put the two verbs of a pair side by side to tell the whole story, the process and then the result: Dlho sme hľadali kaviareň a potom sme ju našli. = We looked for the café for a long time, and then we found it.
An imperfective, then **ale** and the perfective with **ne-**, says someone tried but didn't get there: Hľadali sme kaviareň, ale **ne**našli sme ju. **Snažiť sa** = to try.
t: Butun voqeani — avval jarayonni, keyin natijani — aytish uchun juftlikdagi ikki feʼlni yonma-yon qoʻying: Dlho sme hľadali kaviareň a potom sme ju našli. = Kafeni uzoq qidirdik, keyin uni topdik.

Tugallanmagan feʼl, keyin **ale** (lekin) va **ne-** bilan tugallangan feʼl kimdir urinib koʻrgani, lekin maqsadiga yetmaganini bildiradi: Hľadali sme kaviareň, ale **ne**našli sme ju. = Kafeni qidirdik, lekin topmadik. **Snažiť sa** = harakat qilmoq, urinmoq.

en: Marek looked for his phone for a long time, but he didn't find it.
Emma tried to sleep in the car, but she didn't fall asleep.
t: Marek telefonini uzoq qidirdi, lekin topmadi.
Emma mashinada uxlashga harakat qildi, lekin uxlay olmadi.

a2-u7-l5.fill-marek-sa-snazil.en.en: Marek tried to fall asleep, but he couldn't.
a2-u7-l5.fill-marek-sa-snazil.en.t: Marek uxlashga harakat qildi, lekin uxlay olmadi.

a2-u7-l5.fill-marek-sa-snazil.why.en: He tried (snažil sa) but there was no result: ne- and the perfective, **nezaspal**. Marek is a man, so no -a.
a2-u7-l5.fill-marek-sa-snazil.why.t: U urindi (snažil sa), lekin natija boʻlmadi: ne- va tugallangan tur, **nezaspal**. Marek — erkak, shuning uchun -a yoʻq.

a2-u7-l5.build-hladali-sme-kaviaren.prom.en: We looked for the café, but we didn't find it.

en: You didn't find it: **ne-** goes on the perfective, nenašli.
It's over, so the past: **Hľadali**. Hľadáme is now.
t: Siz uni topmadingiz: **ne-** tugallangan feʼlga qoʻshiladi, nenašli.
Bu tugagan, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon: **Hľadali**. Hľadáme — hozir.

a2-u7-l6.penzion.note.en: A **penzión** is a small hotel. At the **recepcia** (reception), the owner, pani Sokolová, is also the receptionist (**recepčná**): she asks for your **pas** (passport) and gives you the keys.
a2-u7-l6.penzion.note.t: **penzión** — kichik mehmonxona. Qabulxonada (**recepcia**) egasi Sokolova xonim administrator (**recepčná**) vazifasini ham bajaradi: u sizdan **pas** (pasport) soʻraydi va kalitlarni beradi.

a2-u7-l6.mam-rezervaciu.note.en: Na aké meno? – **Na meno** Šimková. = In what name? – In the name of Šimková. Emma booked (**rezervovala**) the rooms by e-mail, under Lucia's surname: three nights, Friday to Monday.
a2-u7-l6.mam-rezervaciu.note.t: Na aké meno? – **Na meno** Šimková. = Kimning nomiga? – Shimkova nomiga. Emma xonalarni elektron xat orqali band qilgan (**rezervovala**), Lusiyaning familiyasiga: uch kecha, jumadan dushanbagacha.

a2-u7-l6.fill-dobry-vecer-mame.en.en: Good evening, we have a reservation in the name of Šimková.
a2-u7-l6.fill-dobry-vecer-mame.en.t: Xayrli kech, Shimkova nomiga joy band qilganmiz.

a2-u7-l6.fill-dobry-vecer-mame.why.en: The reservation is what we have, the object, so -ia changes to **-iu**: máme **rezerváciu**, like konferencia → konferenciu.
a2-u7-l6.fill-dobry-vecer-mame.why.t: Bron — bizda bor narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun -ia oʻrniga **-iu** keladi: máme **rezerváciu**, xuddi konferencia → konferenciu kabi.

a2-u7-l6.ubytovat-sa.en.en: to check in, to get a room

a2-u7-l6.ubytovat-sa.note.en: Kde sa ubytujeme? = Where will we stay? The noun is ubytovanie, from Emma's e-mail to pani Sokolová.
a2-u7-l6.ubytovat-sa.note.t: Kde sa ubytujeme? = Qayerda joylashamiz? Ot shakli — ubytovanie (turar joy), Emmaning Sokolova xonimga yozgan xatidan tanish.

a2-u7-l6.choice-vas-pas-prosim.question.en: The receptionist needs to see Emma's passport. What does she say?
a2-u7-l6.choice-vas-pas-prosim.question.t: Administrator Emmaning pasportini koʻrishi kerak. U nima deydi?

a2-u7-l6.dvojpostelova-izba.note.en: A room for two. A room for one is a **jednoposteľová izba**, and a double bed is a **manželská posteľ**.
a2-u7-l6.dvojpostelova-izba.note.t: Ikki kishi uchun xona. Bir kishilik xona — **jednoposteľová izba**, ikki kishilik katta karavot esa **manželská posteľ**.

a2-u7-l6.fill-emma-rezervovala-dve.en.t: Emma ikkita ikki kishilik xona band qildi.

a2-u7-l6.fill-emma-rezervovala-dve.why.en: Dve izby is plural, and plural things keep **-é** as objects too: dve **dvojposteľové** izby.
a2-u7-l6.fill-emma-rezervovala-dve.why.t: Dve izby — koʻplik, koʻplikdagi narsalar esa toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda ham **-é** ni saqlaydi: dve **dvojposteľové** izby.

a2-u7-l6.fill-dvojpostelova-izba-ma.en.en: A double room has two beds or a double bed.
a2-u7-l6.fill-dvojpostelova-izba-ma.en.t: Ikki kishilik xonada ikkita karavot yoki bitta katta ikki kishilik karavot boʻladi.

a2-u7-l6.fill-dvojpostelova-izba-ma.why.en: The bed is the object of má, and posteľ is feminine: **manželskú**, like dobrú kávu.
a2-u7-l6.fill-dvojpostelova-izba-ma.why.t: Karavot — má feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, posteľ esa ayol jinsida: **manželskú**, xuddi dobrú kávu kabi.

a2-u7-l6.kluc.note.en: Tu sú **kľúče** od izby. = Here are the keys to the room.
a2-u7-l6.kluc.note.t: Tu sú **kľúče** od izby. = Mana xona kalitlari.

a2-u7-l6.build-tu-su-kluce.prompt.en: Here are the keys to the room.

en: Kľúče is plural, so byť is **sú**, not je.
t: Kľúče — koʻplik, shuning uchun byť — **sú**, je emas.

a2-u7-l6.fill-vasa-izba-je.en.en: Your room is on the second floor.

a2-u7-l6.fill-vasa-izba-je.why.en: Where? takes the locative, and nouns in -ie change to **-í**: na druhom **poschodí**.
a2-u7-l6.fill-vasa-izba-je.why.t: «Qayerda?» savoli lokálni talab qiladi, -ie bilan tugaydigan otlar esa **-í** ga oʻzgaradi: na druhom **poschodí**.

a2-u7-l6.ranajky.note.en: Always plural: raňajky **sú** o ôsmej. At a hotel: **Raňajky podávame** od siedmej do desiatej. = We serve breakfast from seven to ten.
a2-u7-l6.ranajky.note.t: Doim koʻplikda: raňajky **sú** o ôsmej (nonushta soat sakkizda). Mehmonxonada: **Raňajky podávame** od siedmej do desiatej. = Nonushta soat yettidan oʻngacha beriladi.

en: From seven to half past ten.
From half past seven to ten.

a2-u7-l6.fill-mate-v-penzione.en.en: Do you have a sauna in the guesthouse too?

a2-u7-l6.fill-mate-v-penzione.why.en: The sauna is what they have, the object, so -a changes to **-u**: máte **saunu**.
a2-u7-l6.fill-mate-v-penzione.why.t: Sauna — ularda bor narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: máte **saunu**.

a2-u7-l6.prajem-vam-prijemny.note.en: **pobyt** = a stay, and **priať** = to wish: prajem, praješ… The receptionist says it as she hands over the keys.
a2-u7-l6.prajem-vam-prijemny.note.t: **pobyt** = biror joyda turish, dam olish muddati, **priať** = tilamoq: prajem, praješ… Administrator kalitlarni berayotib shunday deydi.

a2-u7-l6.build-prajem-vam-prijemny.promp.en: The receptionist to the guests: Enjoy your stay.

en: The receptionist speaks to guests she doesn't know: vy, so **vám**.
Pobyt is masculine, so the adjective ends in **-ý**: **príjemný** pobyt.
t: Administrator notanish mehmonlarga gapiryapti: vy, shuning uchun **vám**.
Pobyt — erkak jinsida, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** bilan tugaydi: **príjemný** pobyt.

a2-u7-l6.speak-dobry-vecer-mam.en.en: Good evening, I have a reservation.

a2-u7-l7.grammar-future-both-aspects.tit.en: The future: budem písať or napíšem
a2-u7-l7.grammar-future-both-aspects.tit.t: Kelasi zamon: budem písať yoki napíšem

en: You know budem + the infinitive from A1. Only **imperfective** verbs take it: **budem písať** = I'll be writing (for a while, or again and again).
A **perfective** verb never takes budem: as lesson 3 showed, its present form is already the future, **napíšem** = I'll write it (and finish). So never budem napísať, never budem kúpiť.
t: Budem + infinitívni A1 dan bilasiz. Uni faqat **tugallanmagan** feʼllar oladi: **budem písať** = yozaman (bir muddat yoki qayta-qayta yozib turaman).

**Tugallangan** feʼl hech qachon budem bilan kelmaydi: 3-darsda koʻrganingizdek, uning hozirgi zamon shakli allaqachon kelasi zamon, **napíšem** = yozaman (va tugataman). Shuning uchun hech qachon budem napísať, budem kúpiť demang.

en: Tomorrow we'll be taking photos all day.
This evening I'll write an e-mail home.
Who's going to buy the tickets?

a2-u7-l7.fill-vecer-zavolam-domov.why.en: Zavolať is perfective, so its present form is already the future: **zavolám**. It never takes budem, and volám is now.
a2-u7-l7.fill-vecer-zavolam-domov.why.t: Zavolať — tugallangan tur, shuning uchun uning hozirgi zamon shakli allaqachon kelasi zamon: **zavolám**. U hech qachon budem bilan kelmaydi, volám esa — hozir.

a2-u7-l7.fill-zajtra-budeme-cely.en.en: Tomorrow we'll be taking photos in the mountains all day.
a2-u7-l7.fill-zajtra-budeme-cely.en.t: Ertaga togʻlarda kun boʻyi suratga olamiz.

a2-u7-l7.fill-zajtra-budeme-cely.why.en: After budeme comes an imperfective infinitive: **fotografovať**. A perfective like odfotografovať never takes budem.
a2-u7-l7.fill-zajtra-budeme-cely.why.t: Budeme dan keyin tugallanmagan infinitív keladi: **fotografovať**. Odfotografovať kabi tugallangan feʼl hech qachon budem bilan kelmaydi.

a2-u7-l7.choice-tomas-bude-cely.question.en: Tomáš will spend the whole evening writing e-mails. Which sentence says so?
a2-u7-l7.choice-tomas-bude-cely.question.t: Tomash butun kechqurun elektron xatlar yozadi. Qaysi gap shuni aytadi?

a2-u7-l7.choice-tomas-bude-cely.why.en: A whole evening is a process, so the imperfective future: **bude písať**. Napíše is a finished result, and bude napísať is never right.
a2-u7-l7.choice-tomas-bude-cely.why.t: Butun kechqurun — jarayon, shuning uchun tugallanmagan turning kelasi zamoni: **bude písať**. Napíše — tugallangan natija, bude napísať esa hech qachon toʻgʻri emas.

a2-u7-l7.build-neboj-sa-najdeme.prompt.en: Don't worry, we'll find the way.

en: Nájsť is perfective: **nájdeme** is already the future, with no budeme.
“We” is my: nájd**eme**. Nájdem is ja.
t: Nájsť — tugallangan tur: **nájdeme** allaqachon kelasi zamon, budeme kerak emas.

a2-u7-l7.fill-neboj-sa-kluce.en.en: Don't worry, I'll find the keys.

a2-u7-l7.fill-neboj-sa-kluce.why.en: One result, later: the perfective **nájdem**, already the future. Never budem nájsť; hľadám is only looking.
a2-u7-l7.fill-neboj-sa-kluce.why.t: Bitta natija, keyinroq: tugallangan **nájdem**, u allaqachon kelasi zamon. Hech qachon budem nájsť demang; hľadám esa faqat qidirish.

a2-u7-l7.grammar-span-or-moment.title.en: For how long, or at what time

en: Saturday's plan, hour by hour. With a time span (od … do …, celý deň, dve hodiny), use the imperfective: Budeme raňajkovať od siedmej do ôsmej.

With the moment something gets done (o + the time), use the perfective: Vstaneme o šiestej. Meal verbs make their perfective with na- and sa: raňajkovať → **naraňajkovať sa**, obedovať → **naobedovať sa**.
t: Shanba kungi reja, soatma-soat. Vaqt oraligʻi bilan (od … do …, celý deň, dve hodiny) tugallanmagan tur ishlatiladi: Budeme raňajkovať od siedmej do ôsmej.

Ish bajariladigan payt bilan (o + soat) tugallangan tur ishlatiladi: Vstaneme o šiestej. Ovqatlanish feʼllari tugallangan turini na- va sa bilan yasaydi: raňajkovať → **naraňajkovať sa**, obedovať → **naobedovať sa**.

en: We'll have breakfast from seven to eight.

a2-u7-l7.fill-zajtra-vstaneme-o.en.en: Tomorrow we'll get up at six.

a2-u7-l7.fill-zajtra-vstaneme-o.why.en: One action at a moment (o šiestej): the perfective **vstaneme**, which is already the future.
a2-u7-l7.fill-zajtra-vstaneme-o.why.t: Muayyan paytdagi bitta harakat (o šiestej): tugallangan **vstaneme**, u allaqachon kelasi zamon.

a2-u7-l7.build-budeme-ranajkovat-od.prom.en: We'll have breakfast from seven to eight.

en: A span (od siedmej do ôsmej) takes the imperfective: budeme **raňajkovať**.
t: Vaqt oraligʻi (od siedmej do ôsmej) tugallanmagan turni talab qiladi: budeme **raňajkovať**.

a2-u7-l7.fill-o-jednej-sa.en.en: We'll have lunch in a restaurant at one.

a2-u7-l7.fill-o-jednej-sa.why.en: With sa and a moment (o jednej), the perfective future: **naobedujeme sa**. Obedovať has no sa, and naobedovali is the past.
a2-u7-l7.fill-o-jednej-sa.why.t: Sa va muayyan payt (o jednej) bilan tugallangan turning kelasi zamoni keladi: **naobedujeme sa**. Obedovať sa olmaydi, naobedovali esa oʻtgan zamon.

a2-u7-l7.choice-budeme-ranajkovat-od.que.en: Which part of the plan is about a time span?
a2-u7-l7.choice-budeme-ranajkovat-od.que.t: Rejaning qaysi qismi vaqt oraligʻi haqida?

a2-u7-l7.choice-budeme-ranajkovat-od.why.en: **Od siedmej do ôsmej** is a span, an hour of breakfast, so the imperfective future: budeme raňajkovať.
a2-u7-l7.choice-budeme-ranajkovat-od.why.t: **Od siedmej do ôsmej** — vaqt oraligʻi, bir soatlik nonushta, shuning uchun tugallanmagan turning kelasi zamoni: budeme raňajkovať.

en: First we'll have breakfast, then we'll go to the mountains.
We'll have breakfast first, then we'll go to the mountains.
t: Avval nonushta qilamiz, keyin togʻlarga boramiz.
Oldin nonushta qilamiz, keyin togʻlarga boramiz.
Avval nonushta qilamiz, soʻng togʻlarga boramiz.

a2-u7-l7.speak-zajtra-vstaneme-o.en.en: We'll get up at six tomorrow.

a2-u7-l8.informacne-centrum.note.en: Saturday morning, before the hike. Here you get a **mapa** (map): Máte mapu Tatier? = Do you have a map of the Tatras?
a2-u7-l8.informacne-centrum.note.t: Shanba kuni ertalab, piyoda sayrdan oldin. Bu yerda **mapa** (xarita) olasiz: Máte mapu Tatier? = Tatra togʻlarining xaritasi bormi?

a2-u7-l8.brozurka.note.en: Tu je brožúrka, je **zadarmo**. = Here's a brochure, it's free.
a2-u7-l8.brozurka.note.t: Tu je brožúrka, je **zadarmo**. = Mana buklet, u bepul.

a2-u7-l8.choice-mate-mapu-tatier.questio.en: Emma wants a map of the Tatras. What does she ask?
a2-u7-l8.choice-mate-mapu-tatier.questio.t: Emmaga Tatra togʻlarining xaritasi kerak. U nima deb soʻraydi?

a2-u7-l8.choice-mate-mapu-tatier.why.en: The map is the object of máte, so mapa changes to **mapu**. And she's asking the staff, so vy: **máte**.
a2-u7-l8.choice-mate-mapu-tatier.why.t: Xarita — máte feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun mapa **mapu** boʻladi. U xodimdan soʻrayapti, shuning uchun vy: **máte**.

a2-u7-l8.fill-tu-je-brozurka.en.en: Here's a brochure about the Tatras, it's free.
a2-u7-l8.fill-tu-je-brozurka.en.t: Mana Tatra togʻlari haqida buklet, u bepul.

a2-u7-l8.fill-tu-je-brozurka.why.en: After tu je, the brochure is the subject, so it stays as it is: **brožúrka**.
a2-u7-l8.fill-tu-je-brozurka.why.t: Tu je dan keyin buklet — ega, shuning uchun oʻzgarmaydi: **brožúrka**.

a2-u7-l8.co-nam-odporucate.note.en: **odporúčať** = to recommend: odporúčam, odporúčaš… A likely answer: Tu si **každý príde na svoje**. = There's something for everyone here.
a2-u7-l8.co-nam-odporucate.note.t: **odporúčať** = tavsiya qilmoq, maslahat bermoq: odporúčam, odporúčaš… Ehtimoliy javob: Tu si **každý príde na svoje**. = Bu yerda har kim oʻziga mos narsa topadi.

a2-u7-l8.build-co-nam-odporucate.prompt.en: Emma asks the woman at the desk: What do you recommend?
a2-u7-l8.build-co-nam-odporucate.prompt.t: Emma xodim ayoldan soʻraydi: Bizga nimani maslahat berasiz?

en: Emma is asking a stranger, so vy: **odporúčate**.
To us is **nám**, as on the card: Čo nám odporúčate?
t: Emma notanish odamdan soʻrayapti, shuning uchun vy: **odporúčate**.

a2-u7-l8.zalezi-na-tom.note.en: What it depends on goes in the locative: **Záleží na počasí.** = It depends on the weather.
a2-u7-l8.zalezi-na-tom.note.t: Nimaga bogʻliqligi lokálda keladi (oʻzbekchada «…ga bogʻliq»): **Záleží na počasí.** = Ob-havoga bogʻliq.

a2-u7-l8.fill-to-zalezi-na.why.en: **Záležať na** takes the locative, and nouns in -ie change to **-í**: na **počasí**.
a2-u7-l8.fill-to-zalezi-na.why.t: **Záležať na** lokálni talab qiladi, -ie bilan tugaydigan otlar esa **-í** ga oʻzgaradi: na **počasí**.

a2-u7-l8.choice-na-slovensku-si.question.en: The brochure says this about Slovakia. What does it mean?
a2-u7-l8.choice-na-slovensku-si.question.t: Bukletda Slovakiya haqida shunday deyilgan. Bu nimani anglatadi?

en: There's something for everyone in Slovakia.
t: Slovakiyada har kim oʻziga mos narsa topadi.

a2-u7-l8.otvorene-a-zatvorene.note.en: Kedy je múzeum **otvorené**? – Od deviatej do piatej. = When is the museum open? – From nine to five.
a2-u7-l8.otvorene-a-zatvorene.note.t: Kedy je múzeum **otvorené**? – Od deviatej do piatej. = Muzey qachon ochiq? – Soat toʻqqizdan beshgacha.

a2-u7-l8.fill-kedy-je-muzeum.why.en: Múzeum is neuter, so the adjective ends in **-é**: otvoren**é**.
a2-u7-l8.fill-kedy-je-muzeum.why.t: Múzeum — oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: otvoren**é**.

a2-u7-l8.choice-muzeum-otvorene-od.quest.en: A sign on the door. Can you visit the museum on Monday?
a2-u7-l8.choice-muzeum-otvorene-od.quest.t: Eshikdagi eʼlon. Dushanba kuni muzeyga borsa boʻladimi?

a2-u7-l8.dakujem-vam-za.note.en: **ochota** = willingness to help. Shorter: Ďakujem za pomoc.
a2-u7-l8.dakujem-vam-za.note.t: **ochota** = yordam berishga tayyorlik. Qisqaroq: Ďakujem za pomoc. (Yordam uchun rahmat.)

a2-u7-l8.choice-dakujem-vam-za.question.en: The woman at the desk has helped them a lot. What does Emma say as she leaves?
a2-u7-l8.choice-dakujem-vam-za.question.t: Xodim ayol ularga koʻp yordam berdi. Emma ketayotib nima deydi?

en: Here's a brochure and a map, they're free.
Here are a brochure and a map, they're free.
t: Mana buklet va xarita, ular bepul.
Mana buklet bilan xarita, ular bepul.

a2-u7-l9.tura.note.en: Ideme **na túru**. = We're going for a hike. Hiking in general is **turistika**: Marek má rád turistiku.
a2-u7-l9.tura.note.t: Ideme **na túru**. = Piyoda sayrga chiqamiz. Umuman piyoda sayohatchilik — **turistika**: Marek má rád turistiku.

a2-u7-l9.turisticky-chodnik.note.en: In town, a **chodník** is the pavement. In the mountains, stay on the trail: ideme po turistickom chodníku.
a2-u7-l9.turisticky-chodnik.note.t: Shaharda **chodník** — piyodalar yoʻlagi (trotuar). Togʻda esa soʻqmoqdan chiqmang: ideme po turistickom chodníku (turistik soʻqmoq boʻylab ketyapmiz).

a2-u7-l9.build-ideme-na-turu.prompt.en: We're going for a hike in the Tatras.

en: Going (ísť na) takes the object form: na **túru**. Na túre is for being on the hike.
Into the mountains is **do Tatier**. V Tatrách is for being there.
t: Borish (ísť na) toʻldiruvchi shaklini talab qiladi: na **túru**. Na túre — sayrda boʻlish uchun.
Togʻlarga — **do Tatier**. V Tatrách — u yerda boʻlish uchun.

a2-u7-l9.fill-ideme-po-turistickom.en.en: We're walking along the hiking trail.

a2-u7-l9.fill-ideme-po-turistickom.why.en: **Po** (along) takes the locative, and after k the ending is **-u**: po chodník**u**, like v parku.
a2-u7-l9.fill-ideme-po-turistickom.why.t: **Po** (…boʻylab) lokálni talab qiladi, k dan keyin esa qoʻshimcha **-u** boʻladi: po chodník**u**, xuddi v parku kabi.

a2-u7-l9.vodopad.note.en: From **voda** (water) and **pád** (a fall). Vodopády sú **prekrásne**! = The waterfalls are gorgeous! (krásny = beautiful)
a2-u7-l9.vodopad.note.t: **voda** (suv) va **pád** (tushish) soʻzlaridan. Vodopády sú **prekrásne**! = Sharsharalar juda goʻzal! (krásny = chiroyli)

a2-u7-l9.fill-hory-su-prekrasne.why.en: Hory is plural, so the adjective takes the -é ending, shortened to **-e** after the long á by the rhythmic law: prekrásn**e**.
a2-u7-l9.fill-hory-su-prekrasne.why.t: Hory — koʻplik, shuning uchun sifat -é qoʻshimchasini oladi, lekin ritm qonuni boʻyicha (ikki choʻziq boʻgʻin ketma-ket kelmaydi) choʻziq á dan keyin u qisqa **-e** boʻladi: prekrásn**e**.

a2-u7-l9.chata.note.en: A **horská chata** is a hut in the mountains where hikers eat and sleep. A chata can also be a weekend cottage.
a2-u7-l9.chata.note.t: **horská chata** — togʻdagi uycha, unda sayyohlar ovqatlanadi va tunaydi. Chata dam olish kunlari boriladigan dala hovli ham boʻlishi mumkin.

a2-u7-l9.build-chata-je-pri.prompt.en: The hut is by the waterfall.

en: **Pri** (by, next to) takes the locative: pri **vodopáde**.

a2-u7-l9.fill-na-horskej-chate.en.en: We had tea at the mountain hut.

a2-u7-l9.fill-na-horskej-chate.why.en: Where? takes the locative: feminine -a changes to **-e**, na horskej **chate**, like v škole.
a2-u7-l9.fill-na-horskej-chate.why.t: «Qayerda?» savoli lokálni talab qiladi: ayol jinsidagi -a **-e** ga oʻzgaradi, na horskej **chate**, xuddi v škole kabi.

a2-u7-l9.les.note.en: **v lese** = in the forest, **do lesa** = into the forest. Forests, mountains, lakes: all that is **príroda** (nature).
a2-u7-l9.les.note.t: **v lese** = oʻrmonda, **do lesa** = oʻrmonga. Oʻrmonlar, togʻlar, koʻllar — bularning hammasi **príroda** (tabiat).

a2-u7-l9.fill-chodnik-ide-najprv.en.en: At first the trail runs in the forest, then it goes to the waterfalls.
a2-u7-l9.fill-chodnik-ide-najprv.en.t: Soʻqmoq avval oʻrmondan oʻtadi, keyin sharsharalarga boradi.

a2-u7-l9.fill-chodnik-ide-najprv.why.en: Where? takes the locative: masculine things add **-e**, v **lese**, like v obchode. Do lesa is for going into it.
a2-u7-l9.fill-chodnik-ide-najprv.why.t: «Qayerda?» lokálni talab qiladi: erkak jinsidagi narsalar **-e** oladi, v **lese**, xuddi v obchode kabi. Do lesa — oʻrmonga kirish uchun.

a2-u7-l9.pleso.note.en: In the Tatras a small lake is a **pleso**; anywhere else it's a **jazero**.
a2-u7-l9.pleso.note.t: Tatra togʻlarida kichik koʻl **pleso** deyiladi; boshqa joylarda esa **jazero**.

a2-u7-l9.fill-v-tatrach-su.en.en: There are beautiful mountain lakes in the Tatras.
a2-u7-l9.fill-v-tatrach-su.en.t: Tatra togʻlarida chiroyli togʻ koʻllari bor.

a2-u7-l9.fill-v-tatrach-su.why.en: More than one: neuter nouns in -o change to **-á** in the plural, ples**á**, like mestá.
a2-u7-l9.fill-v-tatrach-su.why.t: Bittadan ortiq: -o bilan tugaydigan oʻrta jinsdagi otlar koʻplikda **-á** ga oʻzgaradi, ples**á**, xuddi mestá kabi.

a2-u7-l9.kondicia.note.en: After the winter and his arm, Marek is slow. He calls: **Počkajte na mňa!** = Wait for me!
a2-u7-l9.kondicia.note.t: Qishdan keyin va qoʻli tufayli Marek sekin yuryapti. U baqiradi: **Počkajte na mňa!** = Meni kutib turinglar!

a2-u7-l9.fill-marek-este-nema.en.t: Marekning jismoniy holati hali unchalik yaxshi emas.

a2-u7-l9.fill-marek-este-nema.why.en: Kondícia is the object of nemá, so -ia changes to **-iu**: dobrú **kondíciu**.
a2-u7-l9.fill-marek-este-nema.why.t: Kondícia — nemá feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun -ia oʻrniga **-iu** keladi: dobrú **kondíciu**.

a2-u7-l9.choice-pockajte-na-mna.question.en: Marek is tired and far behind the others. What does he call out?
a2-u7-l9.choice-pockajte-na-mna.question.t: Marek charchagan va boshqalardan ancha orqada qoldi. U nima deb baqiradi?

en: Slovak has two verbs for “go”, and both are imperfective. **Ísť** is one trip, happening now or planned: Dnes ideme k vodopádom. **Chodiť** is going again and again, regularly: V lete chodíme do hôr.
Their futures differ: ísť has its own, pôjdem, but chodiť takes budem: **budem chodiť**.
t: Slovak tilida «bormoq» uchun ikki feʼl bor, ikkalasi ham tugallanmagan tur. **Ísť** — bitta qatnov, hozir boʻlayotgan yoki rejalashtirilgan: Dnes ideme k vodopádom. (Bugun sharsharalarga boramiz.) **Chodiť** — qayta-qayta, muntazam borish: V lete chodíme do hôr. (Yozda togʻlarga borib turamiz.)
Ularning kelasi zamoni farq qiladi: ísť feʼlining oʻz kelasi zamoni bor — pôjdem, chodiť esa budem oladi: **budem chodiť**.

en: Tomáš usually goes to Bratislava by train, but he's going on the trip by car.
In the summer I'll go hiking a lot.
t: Tomash odatda Bratislavaga poyezdda qatnaydi, lekin sayohatga mashinada ketyapti.
Yozda tez-tez piyoda sayrga chiqib turaman.

a2-u7-l10.fill-v-lete-chodime.en.en: In the summer we go hiking every weekend.
a2-u7-l10.fill-v-lete-chodime.en.t: Yozda har dam olish kunlari piyoda sayrga chiqamiz.

a2-u7-l10.fill-v-lete-chodime.why.en: Every weekend, again and again: **chodíme**. Ideme is one trip.
a2-u7-l10.fill-v-lete-chodime.why.t: Har dam olish kunlari, qayta-qayta: **chodíme**. Ideme — bitta qatnov.

a2-u7-l10.fill-dnes-ideme-k.en.en: Today we're going to the waterfalls.

a2-u7-l10.fill-dnes-ideme-k.why.en: One trip, today: **ideme**. Chodíme would mean we go there regularly.
a2-u7-l10.fill-dnes-ideme-k.why.t: Bitta qatnov, bugun: **ideme**. Chodíme u yerga muntazam borishimizni bildirardi.

a2-u7-l10.choice-tomas-chodi-do.question.en: Tomáš takes the train to Bratislava twice a week. Which sentence says so?
a2-u7-l10.choice-tomas-chodi-do.question.t: Tomash haftasiga ikki marta Bratislavaga poyezdda boradi. Qaysi gap shuni aytadi?

a2-u7-l10.choice-tomas-chodi-do.why.en: Twice a week is a habit: **chodí**. Ide is one trip now, pôjde one trip later.
a2-u7-l10.choice-tomas-chodi-do.why.t: Haftasiga ikki marta — odat: **chodí**. Ide — hozirgi bitta qatnov, pôjde — keyingi bitta qatnov.

en: One trip, today: **ideme**. Chodíme is for going regularly.
By car: the vehicle goes in the instrumental, **autom**.
t: Bitta qatnov, bugun: **ideme**. Chodíme — muntazam borish uchun.
Mashinada: transport inštrumentálda, yaʼni «bilan» shaklida keladi: **autom** (mashina bilan).

a2-u7-l10.fill-v-lete-budem.en.en: In the summer I'll go hiking regularly.
a2-u7-l10.fill-v-lete-budem.en.t: Yozda muntazam piyoda sayrga chiqib turaman.

a2-u7-l10.fill-v-lete-budem.why.en: Chodiť makes its future with budem: **budem** chodiť. Pôjdem is ísť's own future, for one trip.
a2-u7-l10.fill-v-lete-budem.why.t: Chodiť kelasi zamonni budem bilan yasaydi: **budem** chodiť. Pôjdem — ísť feʼlining oʻz kelasi zamoni, bitta qatnov uchun.

a2-u7-l10.fill-zajtra-pojdeme-na.en.en: Tomorrow we'll go to Štrbské Pleso.

a2-u7-l10.fill-zajtra-pojdeme-na.why.en: One trip tomorrow: ísť, with its own future **pôjdeme**. Never budeme ísť; budeme chodiť is for going regularly.
a2-u7-l10.fill-zajtra-pojdeme-na.why.t: Ertaga bitta qatnov: ísť, oʻzining kelasi zamoni bilan — **pôjdeme**. Hech qachon budeme ísť demang; budeme chodiť — muntazam borish uchun.

en: Leaving and arriving come in pairs too. **Odchádzať** and **prichádzať** are imperfective: the process, a habit or a timetable. **Odísť** and **prísť** are perfective: once, done. They go like ísť: odídem, odišiel.
On a timetable (**cestovný poriadok**): **odchod** = departure, **príchod** = arrival. In the Tatras the little electric train is an **električka** too, like a tram.
t: Ketish va kelish ham juft boʻlib keladi. **Odchádzať** va **prichádzať** — tugallanmagan tur: jarayon, odat yoki jadval. **Odísť** va **prísť** — tugallangan tur: bir marta, bajarildi. Ular ísť kabi tuslanadi: odídem, odišiel.
Jadvalda (**cestovný poriadok**): **odchod** = joʻnash, **príchod** = yetib kelish. Tatra togʻlaridagi kichik elektr poyezdi ham tramvay kabi **električka** deyiladi.

en: The Tatra train leaves every hour.
We left the guesthouse at eight.
We'll get home on Monday evening.
t: Uyga dushanba kuni kechqurun yetib kelamiz.

a2-u7-l10.fill-autobus-do-popradu.en.en: The bus to Poprad leaves every hour.

a2-u7-l10.fill-autobus-do-popradu.why.en: A timetable, every hour: the imperfective **odchádza**. Odíde is one departure, later.
a2-u7-l10.fill-autobus-do-popradu.why.t: Jadval, har soatda: tugallanmagan **odchádza**. Odíde — keyinroq boʻladigan bitta joʻnash.

a2-u7-l10.fill-tomas-odisiel-z.en.en: Tomáš left the hut at three.

a2-u7-l10.fill-tomas-odisiel-z.why.en: One departure, done: the perfective **odišiel**. Odíde is the future.
a2-u7-l10.fill-tomas-odisiel-z.why.t: Bitta ketish, bajarildi: tugallangan **odišiel**. Odíde — kelasi zamon.

a2-u7-l10.build-na-chatu-prideme.prompt.en: We'll get to the hut at eleven.
a2-u7-l10.build-na-chatu-prideme.prompt.t: Uychaga soat oʻn birda yetib boramiz.

en: One arrival, still to come: the perfective **prídeme**, already the future.
Prísť is perfective: **prídeme** already means the future, with no budeme.
t: Bitta yetib kelish, hali oldinda: tugallangan **prídeme**, u allaqachon kelasi zamon.
Prísť — tugallangan tur: **prídeme** allaqachon kelasi zamonni bildiradi, budeme kerak emas.

a2-u7-l10.choice-stary-smokovec-strbske..en: The timetable for the Tatra train. When does it get to Štrbské Pleso?
a2-u7-l10.choice-stary-smokovec-strbske..t: Tatra poyezdining jadvali. U Shtrbske Plesoga soat nechada yetib keladi?

a2-u7-l10.fill-turisti-prichadzali-na.en.en: Hikers kept arriving at the hut all day.
a2-u7-l10.fill-turisti-prichadzali-na.en.t: Sayyohlar kun boʻyi uychaga kelib turishdi.

a2-u7-l10.fill-turisti-prichadzali-na.wh.en: All day, one after another: a process, so the imperfective **prichádzali**.
a2-u7-l10.fill-turisti-prichadzali-na.wh.t: Kun boʻyi, birin-ketin: jarayon, shuning uchun tugallanmagan **prichádzali**.

a2-u7-l11.titleEn.en: Plans for the next few days

a2-u7-l11.mam-jednu-prosbu.en.en: I have a favour to ask.

a2-u7-l11.mam-jednu-prosbu.note.en: **prosba** = a request. Then ask politely: **Je možné** …? = Is it possible to …? The answer may be no: Bohužiaľ, máme všetko **obsadené**. = Sorry, we're fully booked.
a2-u7-l11.mam-jednu-prosbu.note.t: **prosba** = iltimos. Keyin xushmuomalalik bilan soʻrang: **Je možné** …? = …ish mumkinmi? Javob «yoʻq» boʻlishi ham mumkin: Bohužiaľ, máme všetko **obsadené**. = Afsuski, hamma joy band.

a2-u7-l11.predlzit-pobyt.note.en: The four would like to stay longer, but Emma's booking is **len** (only) until Monday. Dokedy chcete **zostať**? – Do utorka. = Until when do you want to stay? – Until Tuesday.
a2-u7-l11.predlzit-pobyt.note.t: Toʻrt doʻst uzoqroq qolmoqchi, lekin Emmaning broni **len** (faqat) dushanbagacha. Dokedy chcete **zostať**? – Do utorka. = Qachongacha qolmoqchisiz? – Seshanbagacha.

a2-u7-l11.fill-je-mozne-predlzit.en.en: Is it possible to extend our stay until Tuesday?

a2-u7-l11.fill-je-mozne-predlzit.why.en: After **je možné** (is it possible) comes the infinitive, the -ť form: **predĺžiť**, as after môžem or musím.
a2-u7-l11.fill-je-mozne-predlzit.why.t: **je možné** (mumkinmi) dan keyin infinitív, yaʼni -ť shakli keladi: **predĺžiť**, xuddi môžem yoki musím dan keyingi kabi.

a2-u7-l11.choice-ubytovanie-mame-len.que.en: Emma explains the problem. What is it?

en: Their rooms are only booked until Monday.
They have to pay by Monday.

a2-u7-l11.fill-mate-volne-izby.en.en: Do you have free rooms for Monday night as well?
a2-u7-l11.fill-mate-volne-izby.en.t: Dushanba kechasiga ham boʻsh xonalaringiz bormi?

a2-u7-l11.fill-mate-volne-izby.why.en: Izby is plural, and plural things keep **-é** as objects too: **voľné** izby.
a2-u7-l11.fill-mate-volne-izby.why.t: Izby — koʻplik, koʻplikdagi narsalar esa toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda ham **-é** ni saqlaydi: **voľné** izby.

a2-u7-l11.choice-bohuzial-na-pondelok.qu.en: What does pani Sokolová tell them?

en: The guesthouse is full on Monday night.
The guesthouse is closed on Mondays.
t: Dushanba kechasi mehmon uyida boʻsh joy yoʻq.

a2-u7-l11.zariadim-to.note.en: **zariadiť** = to arrange. Pani Sokolová: V pondelok môžete mať izbu do dvanástej, zariadim to. = On Monday you can keep the room till twelve, I'll arrange it. Between friends: **Nechaj to na mňa.**
a2-u7-l11.zariadim-to.note.t: **zariadiť** = hal qilmoq, tashkil qilmoq. Sokolova xonim: V pondelok môžete mať izbu do dvanástej, zariadim to. = Dushanba kuni xona soat oʻn ikkigacha sizlarda qolishi mumkin, buni hal qilaman. Doʻstlar orasida: **Nechaj to na mňa.** (Buni menga qoʻyib ber.)

a2-u7-l11.build-nechaj-to-na.prompt.en: Marek to his sister: Leave it to me, Lucia.
a2-u7-l11.build-nechaj-to-na.prompt.t: Marek singlisiga: Buni menga qoʻyib ber, Lusiya.

en: **Na** takes the object form here: na **mňa**, as in pre mňa.
Marek is talking to his sister, so ty: **Nechaj**. Nechajte is for vy.
t: **Na** bu yerda toʻldiruvchi shaklini talab qiladi: na **mňa**, xuddi pre mňa kabi.
Marek singlisi bilan gaplashyapti, shuning uchun ty: **Nechaj**. Nechajte — vy uchun.

a2-u7-l11.choice-dokedy-chcete-zostat.qu.en: How long do they want to stay?

a2-u7-l11.jaskyna.note.en: On Monday they'll visit a cave in the Low Tatras. Lucia: **Najviac** sa teším na jaskyňu! = What I'm looking forward to most is the cave!
a2-u7-l11.jaskyna.note.t: Dushanba kuni ular Past Tatra togʻlaridagi gʻorni koʻrgani borishadi. Lusiya: **Najviac** sa teším na jaskyňu! = Eng koʻp gʻorni intiqlik bilan kutyapman!

a2-u7-l11.fill-v-pondelok-rano.en.en: On Monday morning we'll visit a cave.

a2-u7-l11.fill-v-pondelok-rano.why.en: One visit, later: the perfective **navštívime** is already the future. Navštevujeme is a habit, navštívili the past.
a2-u7-l11.fill-v-pondelok-rano.why.t: Bitta tashrif, keyinroq: tugallangan **navštívime** allaqachon kelasi zamon. Navštevujeme — odat, navštívili — oʻtgan zamon.

a2-u7-l11.kupalisko.note.en: Slovakia and Poland have lots of thermal pools: **termálne kúpalisko**. Ideme na kúpalisko. = We're going to the pool.
a2-u7-l11.kupalisko.note.t: Slovakiya va Polshada termal havzalar koʻp: **termálne kúpalisko**. Ideme na kúpalisko. = Havzaga boramiz.

a2-u7-l11.fill-v-nedelu-vecer.en.en: On Sunday evening we'll go to the swimming pool.
a2-u7-l11.fill-v-nedelu-vecer.en.t: Yakshanba kuni kechqurun suzish havzasiga boramiz.

a2-u7-l11.fill-v-nedelu-vecer.why.en: Going somewhere is **na** + the object form, and neuter -o doesn't change: na **kúpalisko**. Na kúpalisku is for being there.
a2-u7-l11.fill-v-nedelu-vecer.why.t: Biror joyga borish — **na** + toʻldiruvchi shakli, oʻrta jinsdagi -o esa oʻzgarmaydi: na **kúpalisko**. Na kúpalisku — u yerda boʻlish uchun.

a2-u7-l11.zastavit-sa.en.en: to stop off, to drop in

a2-u7-l11.zastavit-sa.note.en: Cestou domov **sa zastavíme** v Banskej Štiavnici. = On the way home we'll stop in Banská Štiavnica. Like kúpim, zastavíme already points to the future.
a2-u7-l11.zastavit-sa.note.t: Cestou domov **sa zastavíme** v Banskej Štiavnici. = Uyga qaytishda Banska Shtyavnitsada toʻxtab oʻtamiz. Kúpim kabi, zastavíme ham allaqachon kelasi zamonni bildiradi.

a2-u7-l11.fill-cestou-do-jaskyne.en.en: On the way to the cave we'll stop in Poprad.

a2-u7-l11.fill-cestou-do-jaskyne.why.en: One stop, still to come: zastaviť sa is perfective, so **zastavíme** is already the future. Zastavujeme would be a habit.
a2-u7-l11.fill-cestou-do-jaskyne.why.t: Bitta toʻxtash, hali oldinda: zastaviť sa — tugallangan tur, shuning uchun **zastavíme** allaqachon kelasi zamon. Zastavujeme odatni bildirardi.

en: Ísť has its own future: **pôjdeme**. Never budeme ísť.
Do (to) takes the same form as z: **do Poľska**, like z Poľska.
t: Ísť feʼlining oʻz kelasi zamoni bor: **pôjdeme**. Hech qachon budeme ísť demang.
Do (…ga) z bilan bir xil shaklni talab qiladi: **do Poľska**, xuddi z Poľska kabi.

en: I'm looking forward to the cave most.
I'm most looking forward to the cave.
t: Eng koʻp gʻorni intiqlik bilan kutyapman.
Hammadan koʻp gʻorni intiqlik bilan kutyapman.
Men eng koʻp gʻorni intiqlik bilan kutyapman.

a2-u7-l11.speak-mam-jednu-prosbu.en.en: I have a favour to ask.

a2-u7-l12.peniaze.note.en: Always plural: peniaze **sú** v aute. On Sunday they go to Zakopane, in Poland, where people pay in **zloté** (złoty).
a2-u7-l12.peniaze.note.t: Doim koʻplikda: peniaze **sú** v aute (pul mashinada). Yakshanba kuni ular Polshadagi Zakopanega borishadi, u yerda **zloté** (zlotiy) bilan toʻlashadi.

a2-u7-l12.zmenaren.note.en: Marek wants cash for Zakopane, so he goes to a **zmenáreň**. Like kaviareň: v zmenárni.
a2-u7-l12.zmenaren.note.t: Marekka Zakopane uchun naqd pul kerak, shuning uchun u **zmenáreň** ga boradi. Kaviareň kabi: v zmenárni.

a2-u7-l12.fill-kde-su-moje.en.en: Where's my money? – Your money is in the car.

a2-u7-l12.fill-kde-su-moje.why.en: Peniaze is always plural, so byť is **sú**, even where English says “is”.
a2-u7-l12.fill-kde-su-moje.why.t: Peniaze doim koʻplikda, shuning uchun byť — **sú**, oʻzbekchada «pul» birlikda boʻlsa ham.

a2-u7-l12.vymenit.note.en: You know vymeniť from the Christmas presents (unit 3), and it works for money too: **vymeniť eurá na zloté**. Marek: Chcel by som vymeniť sto eur. = I'd like to change a hundred euros.
a2-u7-l12.vymenit.note.t: Vymeniť soʻzini Rojdestvo sovgʻalaridan bilasiz (3-boʻlim), u pul uchun ham ishlatiladi: **vymeniť eurá na zloté** (yevroni zlotiyga almashtirmoq). Marek: Chcel by som vymeniť sto eur. = Yuz yevro almashtirmoqchi edim.

a2-u7-l12.fill-potrebujem-vymenit-eura.e.en: I need to change euros into złoty.

a2-u7-l12.fill-potrebujem-vymenit-eura.w.en: After potrebujem comes the infinitive, the -ť form: **vymeniť**, just as after musím or chcem.
a2-u7-l12.fill-potrebujem-vymenit-eura.w.t: Potrebujem dan keyin infinitív, yaʼni -ť shakli keladi: **vymeniť**, xuddi musím yoki chcem dan keyingi kabi.

a2-u7-l12.kurz.note.en: Aký je dnes kurz? = What's the rate today? A kurz is also a course: kurz slovenčiny.
a2-u7-l12.kurz.note.t: Aký je dnes kurz? = Bugun kurs qanday? Kurz oʻquv kursi maʼnosida ham keladi: kurz slovenčiny (slovak tili kursi).

a2-u7-l12.choice-aky-je-dnes.question.en: What is Marek asking at the exchange office?

en: What the exchange rate is today.

a2-u7-l12.bankomat.note.en: Tomáš: Ja si **vyberiem** peniaze z bankomatu. = I'll take some money out of a cash machine.
a2-u7-l12.bankomat.note.t: Tomash: Ja si **vyberiem** peniaze z bankomatu. = Men bankomatdan pul yechib olaman.

a2-u7-l12.build-prepacte-kde-je.prompt.en: Excuse me, where's a cash machine around here?

en: The cash machine is the subject of je, so it stays as it is: **bankomat**.
One machine: **je**. Sú is for more than one.
t: Bankomat — je feʼlining egasi, shuning uchun oʻzgarmaydi: **bankomat**.
Bitta bankomat: **je**. Sú — bittadan ortiq narsa uchun.

a2-u7-l12.poplatok.note.en: Lucia: Pozor, tento bankomat má **poplatok**! = Careful, this cash machine charges a fee!
a2-u7-l12.poplatok.note.t: Lusiya: Pozor, tento bankomat má **poplatok**! = Ehtiyot boʻl, bu bankomat komissiya oladi!

a2-u7-l12.fill-banka-si-berie.en.en: The bank charges a two-euro fee.

a2-u7-l12.fill-banka-si-berie.why.en: The fee is what the bank takes, the object, and masculine things don't change: **poplatok**.
a2-u7-l12.fill-banka-si-berie.why.t: Komissiya — bank oladigan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, erkak jinsidagi narsalar esa oʻzgarmaydi: **poplatok**.

a2-u7-l12.build-vyberiem-peniaze-z.promp.en: I'll take some money out of the cash machine.

en: Vybrať is perfective: **vyberiem** is already the future, with no budem.
Out of (z) the machine: z **bankomatu**, like z Bratislavy.
t: Vybrať — tugallangan tur: **vyberiem** allaqachon kelasi zamon, budem kerak emas.
Bankomatdan (z): z **bankomatu**, xuddi z Bratislavy kabi.

a2-u7-l12.choice-platite-kartou-alebo.qu.en: Monday morning, checking out of the guesthouse. What does the receptionist want to know?
a2-u7-l12.choice-platite-kartou-alebo.qu.t: Dushanba kuni ertalab mehmon uyidan ketish oldidan. Administrator nimani bilmoqchi?

a2-u7-l12.build-kedy-musime-odist.prompt.en: When do we have to leave the room?

en: Leaving once, and done: the perfective **odísť**.
From (z) the room: z **izby**, like kľúče od izby.
t: Xonadan (z): z **izby**, xuddi kľúče od izby kabi.

a2-u7-l12.fill-v-penzione-platime.en.en: At the guesthouse we're paying in cash.
a2-u7-l12.fill-v-penzione-platime.en.t: Mehmon uyida naqd pul bilan toʻlaymiz.

a2-u7-l12.fill-v-penzione-platime.why.en: **V hotovosti** is the locative after v: hotovosť ends in a soft ť, so it takes **-i**, as in Platím v hotovosti.
a2-u7-l12.fill-v-penzione-platime.why.t: **V hotovosti** — v dan keyingi lokál: hotovosť yumshoq ť bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun **-i** oladi, xuddi Platím v hotovosti kabi.

en: The rate is good today, I'll change a hundred euros.
Today the rate is good, I'll change a hundred euros.
t: Bugun kurs yaxshi, yuz yevro almashtiraman.
Kurs bugun yaxshi, yuz yevro almashtiraman.
Bugun kurs yaxshi, men yuz yevro almashtiraman.

a2-u7-l12.speak-kde-je-tu.en.en: Where's an exchange office around here?
a2-u7-l12.speak-kde-je-tu.en.t: Bu yerda valyuta ayirboshlash shoxobchasi qayerda?

a2-u7-l13.sever-a-juh.note.en: **Na severe** = in the north, **na juhu** = in the south. Tatry sú na severe Slovenska.
a2-u7-l13.sever-a-juh.note.t: **Na severe** = shimolda, **na juhu** = janubda. Tatry sú na severe Slovenska. = Tatra togʻlari Slovakiyaning shimolida.

a2-u7-l13.vychod-a-zapad.note.en: **Na východe** = in the east, **na západe** = in the west. Bratislava je na západe.
a2-u7-l13.vychod-a-zapad.note.t: **Na východe** = sharqda, **na západe** = gʻarbda. Bratislava je na západe. = Bratislava gʻarbda.

a2-u7-l13.fill-tomas-byva-v.en.en: Tomáš lives in Košice, in the east of Slovakia.

a2-u7-l13.fill-tomas-byva-v.why.en: **Na** (where?) takes the locative, and masculine things add **-e**: na **východe**, like v obchode.
a2-u7-l13.fill-tomas-byva-v.why.t: **Na** («qayerda?») lokálni talab qiladi, erkak jinsidagi narsalar **-e** oladi: na **východe**, xuddi v obchode kabi.

a2-u7-l13.choice-vysoke-tatry-su.questio.en: Emma reads a brochure at the guesthouse. Where are the High Tatras?
a2-u7-l13.choice-vysoke-tatry-su.questio.t: Emma mehmon uyida buklet oʻqiyapti. Baland Tatra togʻlari qayerda?

en: In the south, on the border with Hungary.
In the north, on the border with Poland.

a2-u7-l13.slovensko-susedi-s.note.en: **susediť s** + the “with” form: s Českom, s Rakúskom, s Maďarskom, s Ukrajinou. The border itself is the **hranica**.
a2-u7-l13.slovensko-susedi-s.note.t: **susediť s** + «bilan» shakli (inštrumentál): s Českom (Chexiya), s Rakúskom (Avstriya), s Maďarskom (Vengriya), s Ukrajinou (Ukraina). Chegaraning oʻzi — **hranica**.

a2-u7-l13.fill-na-juhu-slovensko.en.en: In the south, Slovakia borders Hungary.

a2-u7-l13.fill-na-juhu-slovensko.why.en: **Susediť s** takes the instrumental, the “with” form: neuter -o changes to **-om**, s Maďarsk**om**.
a2-u7-l13.fill-na-juhu-slovensko.why.t: **Susediť s** inštrumentálni, yaʼni «bilan» shaklini talab qiladi: oʻrta jinsdagi -o **-om** ga oʻzgaradi, s Maďarsk**om** (Vengriya bilan).

a2-u7-l13.kraj.note.en: Slovakia has eight **kraje**, each named after its main town: Žilinský kraj, Košický kraj… Lucia is from the Žilina region.
a2-u7-l13.kraj.note.t: Slovakiyada sakkizta **kraje** (viloyat) bor, har biri markaziy shahri nomi bilan ataladi: Žilinský kraj, Košický kraj… Lusiya Jilina viloyatidan.

en: From five up, the noun takes the genitive plural: osem **krajov**, like desať študentov.
After osem (eight) comes the genitive plural: osem **krajov**.
t: Beshdan boshlab ot koʻplikdagi genitív (qaratqich kelishigi) shaklida keladi: osem **krajov**, xuddi desať študentov kabi.
Osem (sakkiz) dan keyin koʻplikdagi genitív keladi: osem **krajov**.

a2-u7-l13.choice-kde-sa-nachadza.questio.en: Kde sa nachádza…? = Where is … (located)? Where is Gerlachovský štít, the highest peak in Slovakia (2,655 m)?
a2-u7-l13.choice-kde-sa-nachadza.questio.t: Kde sa nachádza…? = … qayerda joylashgan? Slovakiyaning eng baland choʻqqisi Gerlachovský štít (2655 m) qayerda joylashgan?

a2-u7-l13.priehrada.note.en: On the way to the Tatras, the road runs along **Liptovská Mara**, a big priehrada on the Váh. The Váh is the longest river in Slovakia; the Dunaj (Danube) is the biggest.
a2-u7-l13.priehrada.note.t: Tatra togʻlariga ketayotganda yoʻl Vah daryosidagi katta priehrada (suv ombori) — **Liptovská Mara** boʻylab oʻtadi. Vah — Slovakiyaning eng uzun daryosi; Dunaj (Dunay) esa eng kattasi.

en: Liptovská Mara is a big reservoir on the Váh.
Liptovská Mara is a big dam on the Váh.
t: Liptovska Mara — Vah daryosidagi katta suv ombori.
Liptovska Mara — Vah daryosidagi katta toʻgʻon.

a2-u7-l13.choice-slovensky-raj-je.questi.en: In the brochure: “raj” means paradise. What is Slovenský raj?

en: A big lake in the Tatras.

a2-u7-l13.fill-bojnicky-zamok-je.why.en: One chateau, the subject of je, so it stays as it is: **zámok**. Zámky is the plural.
a2-u7-l13.fill-bojnicky-zamok-je.why.t: Bitta qasr, je feʼlining egasi, shuning uchun oʻzgarmaydi: **zámok**. Zámky — koʻplik.

a2-u7-l13.ostrov.note.en: Emma compares Slovakia with home: **Írsko je ostrov.** Its highest mountain is only about a thousand metres high.
a2-u7-l13.ostrov.note.t: Emma Slovakiyani oʻz yurti bilan solishtiradi: **Írsko je ostrov.** (Irlandiya — orol.) U yerdagi eng baland togʻ atigi ming metrcha.

a2-u7-l13.build-irsko-je-ostrov.prompt.en: Emma about home: Ireland is an island and it has beautiful lakes.
a2-u7-l13.build-irsko-je-ostrov.prompt.t: Emma oʻz yurti haqida: Irlandiya — orol, unda chiroyli koʻllar bor.

en: After je, the island is simply named: **ostrov**. Na ostrove is for where something is.
Jazerá is plural, so the plural ending, short after the long á: **krásne**.
t: Je dan keyin orol shunchaki nomlanadi: **ostrov**. Na ostrove (orolda) — biror narsa qayerdaligini aytish uchun.
Jazerá — koʻplik, shuning uchun koʻplik qoʻshimchasi, choʻziq á dan keyin qisqa: **krásne**.

a2-u7-l13.fill-irsko-je-na.en.en: Ireland is in the west of Europe.

a2-u7-l13.fill-irsko-je-na.why.en: **Na** (where?) takes the locative, and masculine things add **-e**: na **západe**, like na severe.
a2-u7-l13.fill-irsko-je-na.why.t: **Na** («qayerda?») lokálni talab qiladi, erkak jinsidagi narsalar **-e** oladi: na **západe**, xuddi na severe kabi.

a2-u7-l13.speak-som-z-irska.en.t: Men Irlandiyadanman, u yerda tabiat juda chiroyli.

a2-u7-l14.choice-rano-sme-boli.question.en: Monday morning they were in the cave. What was it like?
a2-u7-l14.choice-rano-sme-boli.question.t: Dushanba kuni ertalab ular gʻorda edi. U yer qanday edi?

a2-u7-l14.fill-v-skanzene-je.en.en: There's an old mine in the open-air museum.

a2-u7-l14.ako-sa-dostaneme.en.en: How do we get to the open-air museum?
a2-u7-l14.ako-sa-dostaneme.en.t: Ochiq osmon ostidagi muzeyga qanday boramiz?

a2-u7-l14.ako-sa-dostaneme.note.en: **dostať sa** = to get (somewhere): dostanem sa, dostaneš sa… A perfective verb, so dostaneme is about the future.
a2-u7-l14.ako-sa-dostaneme.note.t: **dostať sa** = (biror joyga) yetib bormoq: dostanem sa, dostaneš sa… Bu tugallangan feʼl, shuning uchun dostaneme kelasi zamon haqida.

a2-u7-l14.fill-prepacte-ako-sa.en.en: Excuse me, how do we get to the square?

a2-u7-l14.fill-prepacte-ako-sa.why.t: Oʻzimiz haqimizda soʻrayapmiz, yaʼni my: **dostaneme** sa. Dostanete — vy, dostali — oʻtgan zamon.

a2-u7-l14.odbocit.note.en: Choďte rovno a potom **odbočte doľava**. = Go straight on and then turn left. **Po hlavnej ceste** dva **kilometre** = along the main road for two kilometres.
a2-u7-l14.odbocit.note.t: Choďte rovno a potom **odbočte doľava**. = Toʻgʻriga yuring, keyin chapga buriling. **Po hlavnej ceste** dva **kilometre** = asosiy yoʻl boʻylab ikki kilometr.

a2-u7-l14.build-chodte-po-hlavnej.prompt.en: Go along the main road for two kilometres, then turn left.

en: Directions to someone you call vy use the imperative: **odbočte**, like choďte.
t: «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga yoʻl koʻrsatilganda buyruq shakli ishlatiladi: **odbočte**, xuddi choďte kabi.

a2-u7-l14.zabludit.note.en: Emma went off to see the old streets and now… **Zablúdila som!** = I'm lost! **blúdiť** = to wander round, lost.
a2-u7-l14.zabludit.note.t: Emma eski koʻchalarni koʻrgani ketgan edi, endi esa… **Zablúdila som!** = Adashib qoldim! **blúdiť** = adashib aylanib yurmoq.

a2-u7-l14.choice-zabludila-som.question.en: Emma can't find the others. What does she say on the phone?
a2-u7-l14.choice-zabludila-som.question.t: Emma boshqalarni topa olmayapti. U telefonda nima deydi?

a2-u7-l14.choice-zabludila-som.why.en: Emma is a woman, so the past form ends in **-a**: zablúdil**a** som.
a2-u7-l14.choice-zabludila-som.why.t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon shakli **-a** bilan tugaydi: zablúdil**a** som.

a2-u7-l14.fill-pol-hodiny-sme.en.en: We wandered around the town, lost, for half an hour.
a2-u7-l14.fill-pol-hodiny-sme.en.t: Yarim soat shahar boʻylab adashib yurdik.

a2-u7-l14.fill-pol-hodiny-sme.why.en: **Pol hodiny** (for half an hour) is a process: the imperfective **blúdili**. Zablúdili is the moment you get lost.
a2-u7-l14.fill-pol-hodiny-sme.why.t: **Pol hodiny** (yarim soat davomida) — jarayon: tugallanmagan **blúdili**. Zablúdili — adashib qolgan payt.

a2-u7-l15.fill-prosim-si-dve.why.en: After 2, 3 and 4 comes the plural: dve **známky**, like dve rieky.
a2-u7-l15.fill-prosim-si-dve.why.t: 2, 3 va 4 dan keyin koʻplik keladi: dve **známky**, xuddi dve rieky kabi.

a2-u7-l15.fill-poslem-pohladnicu-domov.e.en: I'll send a postcard home to Dublin.

a2-u7-l15.fill-poslem-pohladnicu-domov.w.en: The postcard is what I send, the object, so -a changes to **-u**: pošlem **pohľadnicu**.
a2-u7-l15.fill-poslem-pohladnicu-domov.w.t: Ochiq xat — men yuboradigan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: pošlem **pohľadnicu**.

a2-u7-l15.pozdrav-z-tatier.note.en: The start of a holiday card: **Pozdrav z** + the place. Or: Pozdravujem vás zo Slovenska! = Greetings to you all from Slovakia!
a2-u7-l15.pozdrav-z-tatier.note.t: Dam olishdan yuboriladigan ochiq xatning boshlanishi: **Pozdrav z** + joy nomi. Yoki: Pozdravujem vás zo Slovenska! = Hammangizga Slovakiyadan salom!

en: After z (from), Slovensko changes as in Som zo Slovenska: **zo Slovenska**.
Before s, z becomes **zo**: zo Slovenska.
t: Z (…dan) dan keyin Slovensko xuddi Som zo Slovenska dagi kabi oʻzgaradi: **zo Slovenska**.
s dan oldin z **zo** boʻladi: zo Slovenska.

a2-u7-l15.nezabudnutelny.note.en: From **zabudnúť** (to forget): something you'll never forget.

a2-u7-l15.fill-bol-to-nezabudnutelny.why.en: Výlet is masculine, so the adjective ends in **-ý**: nezabudnuteľn**ý**.
a2-u7-l15.fill-bol-to-nezabudnutelny.why.t: Výlet — erkak jinsida, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** bilan tugaydi: nezabudnuteľn**ý**.

a2-u7-l15.choice-ahojte-pozdravujem-vas..en: Emma's postcard. How is the trip going?
a2-u7-l15.choice-ahojte-pozdravujem-vas..t: Emmaning ochiq xati. Sayohat qanday oʻtyapti?

a2-u7-l15.pozdravuj-mamu.note.en: Like **Pozdravuj Mareka!** in Emma's e-mails (unit 6). Lucia's card to her little cousin Samko ends like this. To vy: **Pozdravujte**…
a2-u7-l15.pozdravuj-mamu.note.t: Emmaning elektron xatlaridagi **Pozdravuj Mareka!** kabi (6-boʻlim). Lusiyaning kichkina togʻavachchasi Samkoga yozgan ochiq xati shunday tugaydi. «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: **Pozdravujte**…

Samko is a child in the family, so ty: **pozdravuj**.
