Samko — oiladagi bola, shuning uchun ty: **pozdravuj**.

a2-u7-l15.majte-sa-pekne.note.en: The end of a card to several people. To one person: **Maj sa pekne!**
a2-u7-l15.majte-sa-pekne.note.t: Bir necha kishiga yozilgan ochiq xatning oxiri. Bitta odamga: **Maj sa pekne!**

a2-u7-l15.choice-ako-konci-emma.question.en: How does Emma end her postcard to the whole family?
a2-u7-l15.choice-ako-konci-emma.question.t: Emma butun oilaga yozgan ochiq xatini qanday tugatadi?

a2-u7-l15.choice-ako-konci-emma.why.en: The card is for the whole family, several people, so the vy form: **Majte** sa pekne. Maj sa is for one person.
a2-u7-l15.choice-ako-konci-emma.why.t: Ochiq xat butun oila, yaʼni bir necha kishi uchun, shuning uchun vy shakli: **Majte** sa pekne. Maj sa — bitta odam uchun.

a2-u7-l15.build-v-nedelu-sme.prompt.en: Emma writes: On Sunday we were in Poland.
a2-u7-l15.build-v-nedelu-sme.prompt.t: Emma yozadi: Yakshanba kuni Polshada edik.

en: Where? takes the locative: v **Poľsku**, like na Slovensku.
Sunday is over, so the past: **sme** boli. Budeme is the future.
t: «Qayerda?» lokálni talab qiladi: v **Poľsku**, xuddi na Slovensku kabi.
Yakshanba oʻtdi, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon: **sme** boli. Budeme — kelasi zamon.

en: Marek is sending a postcard to Veronika too.
Marek is also sending a postcard to Veronika.
t: Marek Veronikaga ham ochiq xat yuboryapti.
Marek ochiq xatni Veronikaga ham yuboryapti.

a2-u7-l16.grammar-ked-kym-aspect.title.en: Keď and kým: how two actions fit
a2-u7-l16.grammar-ked-kym-aspect.title.t: Keď va kým: ikki harakat qanday bogʻlanadi

en: **Keď** = when, **kým** = while. The aspects of the two verbs show how the two actions fit together in time.

Both imperfective: they were going on at the same time. Both perfective: one happened, then the other. An imperfective and a perfective: one event happened during a process, or, with the perfective first, a process began after an event.
t: **Keď** = qachonki, …ganda; **kým** = …ayotganda. Ikki feʼlning turi ikki harakat vaqt jihatidan qanday bogʻlanishini koʻrsatadi.

Ikkalasi tugallanmagan: ular bir vaqtda davom etgan. Ikkalasi tugallangan: biri boʻldi, keyin ikkinchisi. Biri tugallanmagan, biri tugallangan: bir voqea jarayon davomida yuz bergan yoki, tugallangan feʼl birinchi kelsa, voqeadan keyin jarayon boshlangan.

en: While Tomáš was driving, Emma slept.
When we got to the hut, we bought some tea.
While we were waiting for the tour, Lucia bought some postcards.
When we'd had dinner, we talked about the trip for a long time.
t: Uychaga yetib kelganimizda choy sotib oldik.
Ekskursiyani kutayotganimizda Lusiya ochiq xatlar sotib oldi.
Kechki ovqatni yeb boʻlgach, sayohat haqida uzoq gaplashdik.

a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-prisli.en.en: When we got to the guesthouse, we got the keys.

a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-prisli.why.en: The arrival is over (keď sme prišli), so the next step is in the past too, one action done: **dostali**. Dostaneme is the future.
a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-prisli.why.t: Kelish tugagan (keď sme prišli), shuning uchun keyingi qadam ham oʻtgan zamonda, bir marta bajarilgan harakat: **dostali**. Dostaneme — kelasi zamon.

a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-zjedli.en.en: When we'd finished dinner, Marek paid.
a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-zjedli.en.t: Kechki ovqatni yeb boʻlgach, Marek pul toʻladi.

a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-zjedli.why.en: One thing done, then the next: keď + the perfective **zjedli** (dinner finished), then zaplatil.
a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-zjedli.why.t: Bir ish tugadi, keyin keyingisi: keď + tugallangan **zjedli** (kechki ovqat tugadi), keyin zaplatil.

a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-sme-cakali.en.en: While we were waiting for the tour, Lucia bought two postcards.
a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-sme-cakali.en.t: Ekskursiyani kutayotganimizda Lusiya ikkita ochiq xat sotib oldi.

a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-sme-cakali.why.en: Lucia did it once and finished it while the others waited: the perfective **kúpila**. Kupovala would mean she was busy buying the whole time.
a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-sme-cakali.why.t: Boshqalar kutayotganda Lusiya buni bir marta qilib, tugatdi: tugallangan **kúpila**. Kupovala u butun vaqt xarid bilan band boʻlganini bildirardi.

a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-emma-pisala.en.en: While Emma was writing postcards, Lucia was reading the brochure.
a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-emma-pisala.en.t: Emma ochiq xatlar yozayotganda Lusiya buklet oʻqiyotgan edi.

a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-emma-pisala.why.en: Two things going on at the same time: kým with two imperfectives, **písala** and čítala.
a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-emma-pisala.why.t: Bir vaqtda davom etgan ikki ish: kým ikki tugallanmagan feʼl bilan, **písala** va čítala.

a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-sa.en.en: When we'd had dinner, we talked about the hike for a long time.
a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-sa.en.t: Kechki ovqatdan keyin piyoda sayr haqida uzoq gaplashdik.

a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-sa.why.en: After the dinner (done), a long process began: **dlho** + the imperfective **hovorili**.
a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-sme-sa.why.t: Kechki ovqat tugagach, uzoq jarayon boshlandi: **dlho** (uzoq) + tugallanmagan **hovorili**.

en: While Marek was taking photos, we drank tea.
While Marek was taking photos, we were drinking tea.
t: Marek suratga olayotganda biz choy ichdik.
Marek suratga olayotganda biz choy ichayotgan edik.

a2-u7-l16.grammar-before-after-once.titl.en: After, before, once: potom ako, predtým ako, až
a2-u7-l16.grammar-before-after-once.titl.t: Keyin, oldin, …gach: potom ako, predtým ako, až

en: **Potom ako** = after, **predtým ako** = before. **Najprv** … **potom** … (first … then …) you know from A1.
About the future, **keď** and **až** (once, as soon as) take a perfective future: Keď prídeme domov, zavolám mame.
t: **Potom ako** = …gandan keyin, **predtým ako** = …ishdan oldin. **Najprv** … **potom** … (avval … keyin …) sizga A1 dan tanish.
Kelajak haqida gapirganda **keď** va **až** (…gach, …ishi bilan) tugallangan turning kelasi zamonini oladi: Keď prídeme domov, zavolám mame. = Uyga kelgach, oyimga qoʻngʻiroq qilaman.

en: After we'd had breakfast, we went for a hike.
Before we go home, we'll buy postcards.
When we get home, I'll call Mum.
Once you get the postcard, write to me.
t: Nonushta qilib boʻlgach, piyoda sayrga chiqdik.
Uyga ketishdan oldin ochiq xatlar sotib olamiz.
Ochiq xatni olishingiz bilan menga yozing.

a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-marek-soferoval.en.en: While Marek was driving, Tomáš slept.

a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-marek-soferoval.why.en: Two things going on at the same time: **kým** (while), with two imperfectives.
a2-u7-l16.fill-kym-marek-soferoval.why.t: Bir vaqtda davom etgan ikki ish: **kým** (…ayotganda), ikki tugallanmagan feʼl bilan.

a2-u7-l16.build-ked-pridem-domov.prompt.en: When we get home, I'll call Mum.

en: Getting home is one event in the future: the perfective **prídeme**.
One call, later: **zavolám**, the perfective future. Volám is now.
t: Uyga kelish — kelajakdagi bitta voqea: tugallangan **prídeme**.
Bitta qoʻngʻiroq, keyinroq: **zavolám**, tugallangan turning kelasi zamoni. Volám — hozir.

a2-u7-l16.fill-predtym-ako-pojdeme.en.en: Before we go home, we'll buy postcards.
a2-u7-l16.fill-predtym-ako-pojdeme.en.t: Uyga ketishdan oldin ochiq xatlar sotib olamiz.

a2-u7-l16.fill-predtym-ako-pojdeme.why.en: The postcards come first, before going home: **predtým ako** (before).
a2-u7-l16.fill-predtym-ako-pojdeme.why.t: Avval ochiq xatlar, keyin uyga ketish: **predtým ako** (…dan oldin).

a2-u7-l16.fill-potom-ako-sme.en.en: After we'd had breakfast, we went to the waterfalls.

a2-u7-l16.fill-potom-ako-sme.why.en: **Potom ako** (after) needs the first action finished: the perfective **naraňajkovali** sa.
a2-u7-l16.fill-potom-ako-sme.why.t: **Potom ako** (…gandan keyin) birinchi harakat tugagan boʻlishini talab qiladi: tugallangan **naraňajkovali** sa.

a2-u7-l16.choice-az-prides-zavolaj.quest.en: Which one means “Once you get here, call me”?
a2-u7-l16.choice-az-prides-zavolaj.quest.t: Qaysi biri «Yetib kelgach, menga qoʻngʻiroq qil» degani?

a2-u7-l16.choice-az-prides-zavolaj.why.en: **Až** + the perfective future = once it has happened: Až prídeš… Kým is while, predtým ako is before.
a2-u7-l16.choice-az-prides-zavolaj.why.t: **Až** + tugallangan turning kelasi zamoni = voqea yuz bergach: Až prídeš… Kým — …ayotganda, predtým ako — …dan oldin.

a2-u7-l16.fill-az-pridem-domov.en.en: Once I get home, I'll call you.
a2-u7-l16.fill-az-pridem-domov.en.t: Uyga yetib borgach, sizga qoʻngʻiroq qilaman.

a2-u7-l16.fill-az-pridem-domov.why.en: **Až** (once) takes the perfective future: one arrival, **prídem**. Prichádzam is now, and budem prichádzať a process.
a2-u7-l16.fill-az-pridem-domov.why.t: **Až** (…gach) tugallangan turning kelasi zamonini oladi: bitta yetib kelish, **prídem**. Prichádzam — hozir, budem prichádzať esa jarayon.

a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-napisem-pohladnicu.en.en: When I've written the postcard, I'll send it home.
a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-napisem-pohladnicu.en.t: Ochiq xatni yozib boʻlgach, uni uyga yuboraman.

a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-napisem-pohladnicu.wh.en: One finished action in the future, then the next: keď + the perfective future **napíšem**.
a2-u7-l16.fill-ked-napisem-pohladnicu.wh.t: Kelajakdagi bitta tugallangan harakat, keyin keyingisi: keď + tugallangan turning kelasi zamoni **napíšem**.

a2-u7-l16.build-najprv-si-kupime.prompt.en: First we'll buy the tickets, then we'll go to the castle.
a2-u7-l16.build-najprv-si-kupime.prompt.t: Avval chiptalarni sotib olamiz, keyin qalʼaga boramiz.

en: Buying the tickets is one finished action: the perfective **kúpime**, already the future.
Ísť has its own future: **pôjdeme**. Never budeme ísť.
t: Chiptalarni sotib olish — bitta tugallangan harakat: tugallangan **kúpime**, u allaqachon kelasi zamon.
Ísť feʼlining oʻz kelasi zamoni bor: **pôjdeme**. Hech qachon budeme ísť demang.

a2-u7-l16.build-v-pondelok-sme.prompt.en: Emma tells pán Kováč: On Monday we stopped off in Banská Štiavnica.
a2-u7-l16.build-v-pondelok-sme.prompt.t: Emma janob Kovachga aytadi: Dushanba kuni Banska Shtyavnitsada toʻxtab oʻtdik.

en: Monday is over, so the past: sme sa **zastavili**. Zastavíme is the future.
It's **zastaviť sa**, with sa: sme **sa** zastavili.
t: Dushanba oʻtdi, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon: sme sa **zastavili**. Zastavíme — kelasi zamon.
Bu **zastaviť sa**, sa bilan: sme **sa** zastavili.

a2-u7-l16.speak-ked-pridem-domov.en.en: When we get home, I'll call Mum.

a2-u7-pisanie.listen-mame-rezervaciu-na..en: We have a reservation for three nights.

a2-u7-pisanie.listen-zajtra-pojdeme-na.e.en: Tomorrow we'll go on a hike to the waterfall.

a2-u7-pisanie.listen-na-chate-sme.en.en: We bought some tea at the hut.

a2-u7-pisanie.listen-kde-je-tu.en.en: Where's a cash machine around here?

a2-u7-pisanie.listen-prehliadka-trva-hod.en: The tour takes an hour and a half.
a2-u7-pisanie.listen-prehliadka-trva-hod.t: Ekskursiya bir yarim soat davom etadi.

a2-u7-pisanie.listen-vecer-napisem-pohla.en: This evening I'll write a postcard home.

a2-u7-pisanie.listen-v-lete-budem.en.en: In the summer I'll go to the mountains a lot.

a2-u7-pisanie.listen-ked-pridem-domov.en.en: When I get home, I'll call you.

a2-u7-l17.fill-tomas-cely-vecer.en.en: Tomáš was writing e-mails all evening.
a2-u7-l17.fill-tomas-cely-vecer.en.t: Tomash butun kechqurun elektron xatlar yozdi.

a2-u7-l17.fill-tomas-cely-vecer.why.en: **Celý večer** (all evening) is a process: the imperfective **písal**.

a2-u7-l17.choice-prehliadka-je-vypredana.en: Listen. What does the cashier say?

en: Zostať is perfective: **zostaneme** is already the future, with no budeme.
Until (do) changes the day: **do pondelka**, as the receptionist said.
t: Zostať — tugallangan tur: **zostaneme** allaqachon kelasi zamon, budeme kerak emas.
Do (…gacha) kun nomini oʻzgartiradi: **do pondelka**, administrator aytganidek.

a2-u7-l17.fill-obycajne-chodim-vlakom.en.en: I usually go by train, but today I'm going by car.
a2-u7-l17.fill-obycajne-chodim-vlakom.en.t: Odatda poyezdda qatnayman, lekin bugun mashinada ketyapman.

a2-u7-l17.fill-obycajne-chodim-vlakom.wh.en: **Obyčajne** is a habit, so **chodím**. Idem is for the one trip today, as in the second half.
a2-u7-l17.fill-obycajne-chodim-vlakom.wh.t: **Obyčajne** — odat, shuning uchun **chodím**. Idem — bugungi bitta qatnov uchun, gapning ikkinchi qismidagi kabi.

a2-u7-l17.fill-ked-sme-prisli.en.en: When we got to the castle, we bought tickets.

a2-u7-l17.fill-ked-sme-prisli.why.en: One event, then the next: keď + the perfective **prišli**.
a2-u7-l17.fill-ked-sme-prisli.why.t: Bir voqea, keyin keyingisi: keď + tugallangan **prišli**.

a2-u7-l17.build-mate-volnu-dvojpostelovu.en: Do you have a free double room?

en: The room is the object of máte, so -á changes to **-ú**: **voľnú** izbu.
Same rule: the object form, -á changes to **-ú**: **dvojposteľovú** izbu.
t: Xona — máte feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun -á **-ú** ga oʻzgaradi: **voľnú** izbu.
Xuddi shu qoida: toʻldiruvchi shakli, -á **-ú** ga oʻzgaradi: **dvojposteľovú** izbu.

a2-u7-l17.choice-zajtra-pojdeme-do.why.en: Ísť has its own future, **pôjdeme**: never budeme ísť. Išli sme is the past, which doesn't fit zajtra.
a2-u7-l17.choice-zajtra-pojdeme-do.why.t: Ísť feʼlining oʻz kelasi zamoni bor, **pôjdeme**: hech qachon budeme ísť emas. Išli sme — oʻtgan zamon, u zajtra (ertaga) bilan mos kelmaydi.

a2-u7-l17.fill-emma-hladala-mobil.en.en: Emma looked for her phone, but she didn't find it.

a2-u7-l17.fill-emma-hladala-mobil.why.en: She tried but got no result: the imperfective **hľadala**, then ale and the perfective with ne-, nenašla.
a2-u7-l17.fill-emma-hladala-mobil.why.t: U urindi, lekin natija boʻlmadi: tugallanmagan **hľadala**, keyin ale va ne- bilan tugallangan feʼl, nenašla.

en: While we were in the cave, Marek took photos.
While we were in the cave, Marek was taking photos.
t: Biz gʻorda boʻlganimizda Marek suratga oldi.
Biz gʻorda boʻlganimizda Marek suratga olayotgan edi.

a2-u7-l17.fill-tatry-su-na.en.en: The Tatras are in the north of Slovakia.

a2-u7-l17.fill-tatry-su-na.why.en: **Na** (where?) takes the locative, and masculine things add **-e**: na **severe**.
a2-u7-l17.fill-tatry-su-na.why.t: **Na** («qayerda?») lokálni talab qiladi, erkak jinsidagi narsalar **-e** oladi: na **severe**.

a2-u7-l17.build-predtym-ako-pojdeme.prom.en: Before we go home, we'll stop off in Banská Štiavnica.
a2-u7-l17.build-predtym-ako-pojdeme.prom.t: Uyga ketishdan oldin Banska Shtyavnitsada toʻxtab oʻtamiz.

en: Ísť has its own future: **pôjdeme**. Never budeme ísť.
The stop is still to come: the perfective future **zastavíme**. Zastavili is the past.
t: Ísť feʼlining oʻz kelasi zamoni bor: **pôjdeme**. Hech qachon budeme ísť demang.
Toʻxtash hali oldinda: tugallangan turning kelasi zamoni **zastavíme**. Zastavili — oʻtgan zamon.

a2-u7-l17.choice-ako-bolo-na.question.en: Back at the dorm, pán Kováč asks: Ako bolo na výlete? Emma loved it. What does she say?
a2-u7-l17.choice-ako-bolo-na.question.t: Yotoqxonaga qaytgach, janob Kovach soʻraydi: Ako bolo na výlete? Emmaga sayohat juda yoqdi. U nima deydi?
